Overview

Build the Future
At McGraw Hill, we create best-in-class, next-generation learning experiences that are used by millions of students and educators worldwide every day. We design intuitive and effective tools that maximize teachers’ time and students’ learning. And we do all of this in a supportive and collaborative environment where we work alongside brilliant colleagues, touch lives around the world, see the difference our hard work makes, and continue on our own paths of lifelong learning.

How can you make an impact?

As a Lead Data Scientist, you will join a team of data scientists, AI researchers, psychometricians, and software developers who provide technical and scientific leadership for some of our most important strategic efforts companywide. You will independently apply advanced DS/AI techniques to solve complex problems that drive business outcomes for our School (PreK–12) business unit, bringing together deep expertise in educational measurement and a thorough understanding of what it takes to operationalize and sustain quantitative models in production. You will develop innovative methodologies and scalable solutions, foster collaboration across teams, facilitate alignment with organizational strategic goals, and provide technical mentorship to enhance team capabilities. You will collaborate closely with colleagues across functions like Product, Engineering, Learning Design, and User Experience to help McGraw Hill create and deliver world-class educational experiences.

This is a remote position open to applicants authorized to work for any employer within the United States.

What You'll Do:

  • Independently apply advanced data science and AI techniques to solve complex problems that drive meaningful business outcomes for the School (PreK–12) business unit
  • Develop innovative methodologies, scalable solutions, and structured frameworks to address ambiguous and complex challenges in K–12 educational contexts
  • Apply acquired professional knowledge to interpret internal business issues and recommend DS/AI solutions and best practices in line with business goals
  • Operate with substantial independence, planning and executing projects with minimal oversight while seeking leadership input for strategic alignment
  • Foster cross-team collaboration across technical and non-technical teams, communicating complex measurement and DS/AI concepts clearly to diverse stakeholders using data-driven storytelling
  • Provide technical mentorship to peers, fostering collaboration and facilitating alignment with organizational goals

What You Bring:

  • Doctoral degree (or equivalent) in Data Science, Psychometrics, Statistics, Quantitative Methods, Applied Math, or a related field
  • 4-7 years of professional experience with a demonstrated ability to deliver impactful DS/AI projects
  • Advanced knowledge in DS/AI with demonstrated industry experience applying these techniques to complex, real-world problems
  • Demonstrated ability to take DS/AI models through their full operational lifecycle, from research and validation into deployed products, including implementation, ongoing monitoring, validation, and periodic recalibration
  • Ability to think through and communicate about system design, scaling, and pipeline architecture to ensure models are implemented faithfully and maintained reliably in production systems, and to collaborate effectively with engineering partners
  • Strong Python skills with experience writing production-quality, scalable code
  • Strong technical communication and collaboration skills, particularly with non-technical stakeholders

Preferred:

  • Commitment to the field of education and the mission of improving K–12 student outcomes
  • Experience working at an assessment company, adaptive learning platform, or edtech company that ships proficiency-based or adaptive/personalization products
  • Familiarity with K–12 assessment ecosystems, including standards alignment, score reporting, adaptive assessment, and personalization
  • Familiarity with ML, NLP, Deep Learning, and/or Generative AI approaches, particularly in educational contexts

Why work for us?

The work you do at McGraw Hill will be work that matters. We are collectively building experiences that will help shape the future of education. Play your part and experience a sense of fulfilment that will inspire you to even greater heights.

The pay range for this position is between $140,000 - $190,000 annually. However, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location. Location: USA Remote, Eastern Time zone 9-5ET


About Time4Learning

Interested in educational technology and helping families find learning solutions that work for their students? Time4Learning, a Cambium® Learning Group Brand, provides award-winning online curriculum, resources, and educational programs that support students and families across a variety of learning environments.


Our Company. Time4Learning offers online curriculum and educational solutions for at-home and non-traditional learning environments. Our portfolio includes Time4Learning, an online PreK-12 core and supplemental curriculum; Homeschool.com Marketplace, a trusted destination for families exploring home education; and Brightspire Virtual School, an accredited online school serving students in grades 6-12.


Our Team. Time4Learning is a remote-first organization with team members across the country. As a long-standing leader in home education, we are passionate about creating flexible, meaningful learning opportunities for students and supporting families as they find the educational path that works for them.


Our Culture. We value diversity of thought, experience, and approach. Our team works collaboratively and with purpose while creating opportunities to connect, learn from one another, and have fun along the way.


Job Overview

Time4Learning is seeking an Enrollment Specialist - Inside Sales to help prospective families identify and select the educational solution that best meets their needs.


This role combines consultative inside sales with a high standard of customer support. The Enrollment Specialist will develop deep expertise in Brightspire Virtual School, while building knowledge of our broader portfolio.

You will be responsible for engaging prospective families, understanding their needs, recommending appropriate solutions, and guiding them through the decision-making process. Responsibilities include responding to inbound interest, proactive follow-up and outreach, consultative discovery, pipeline management, and supporting families through appropriate enrollment steps.


Key Responsibilities

  • Respond to and qualify inbound prospects through phone, email, chat and other designated channels.
  • Conduct proactive outbound follow-up and outreach with prospective families and warm leads.
  • Use consultative discovery to understand student and family needs and recommend appropriate educational solutions.
  • Develop strong expertise in Brightspire Virtual School, including benefits, pricing, positioning and ideal customer fit.
  • Guide qualified prospects through the decision-making process to drive new enrollments.
  • Support prospective Brightspire families through appropriate portions of the admissions and enrollment process and identify opportunities where another solution within our portfolio may be a better fit.
  • Manage consultation appointments, follow-up, and pipeline activity while maintaining accurate and timely records in Salesforce.
  • Consistently work toward established activity, conversion, enrollment, and revenue goals while sharing customer insights that can improve the overall sales and enrollment experience.

This role may require occasional evening or Saturday availability during peak enrollment periods.


Job Requirements

  • 2+ years of inside sales, admissions, enrollment or other customer-facing sales experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to understand customer needs and guide prospects toward a purchase or enrollment decision.
  • Comfortable working in a goal-oriented sales environment with individual and team performance metrics.
  • Strong consultative selling, customer service, and verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to effectively manage a high volume of inbound and outbound prospect interactions and follow-up activities.
  • Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • Experience with Salesforce or another CRM preferred.
  • Experience in education, EdTech, SaaS, virtual school, admissions, or enrollment preferred.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish proficiency is a plus.

Why Work With Us
At Time4Learning, you’ll have the opportunity to help families find flexible educational solutions that can make a meaningful difference for their students. As part of Cambium Learning Group, you’ll contribute to a broader purpose of helping teachers and students feel seen, valued, and supported while growing your career with an organization focused on improving educational outcomes.


To learn more about our organization and the exciting work we do, visit .

Remote First Work Environment

Our Remote First approach gives employees the flexibility and trust they need to effectively balance work with life. It creates a culture in which all employees are valued and where success is measured in results. It allows us to work collaboratively, inclusively and for greater positive impact, regardless of our individual locations.

If you will be working remotely, either occasionally or on a permanent basis, you must have a reliable internet connection through a cable or fiber-optic broadband service with minimum speeds of 10 Mbps download and 5 Mbps upload.

The successful candidate will be expected to actively participate in video-based interviews during the recruiting process and ongoing virtual meetings with their camera on, as part of their role. To maintain confidentiality and ensure a fair evaluation process, the use of note-taking tools, reference materials, or AI-powered tools (including generative AI, language models, or similar technologies) during interviews or other selection activities is prohibited unless prior written approval has been obtained from the People Experience team. If you require an exception for medical, accessibility, or other reasons, please contact your Talent Acquisition team member to discuss accommodations in advance.

As part of our Remote-First benefits, Cambium offers reimbursement to help cover the cost of setting up your home or remote office.

An Equal Opportunity Employer

We are dedicated to fostering a culture that celebrates unique backgrounds, ideas, and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, color, age, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender, gender identity/expression, or sexual orientation), national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or genetic information (including family medical history).

We will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. You may request an accommodation during the recruiting process with your Talent Acquisition team member.

Help Modernize the U.S. Army's Global Network!

Leidos is seeking a Mid-Level Orchestration Event Management Engineer to support the Army Global Unified Network (AGUN) Migration team.

In this remote role, you'll help improve the Army's global network through event management, network monitoring, automation, and real-time data analytics.

You'll work with engineering, cybersecurity, and operations teams to develop data pipelines, monitor network performance, troubleshoot issues, and support infrastructure modernization.

We're looking for someone with experience in Elastic, Linux, network monitoring, and orchestration technologies.

  • Develop and maintain real-time data streaming, event management, and automation workflows.

  • Administer Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) systems, including patching and security hardening.
  • Build and maintain monitoring dashboards, logging systems, and data ingestion pipelines.
  • Analyze network events, performance, and system health using SNMPv3 and network telemetry.
  • Support Kubernetes, containerized applications, and virtualization environments.
  • Troubleshoot network monitoring, orchestration, and infrastructure issues.
  • Support network migrations, systems integration, testing, and validation.
  • Implement DoD cybersecurity requirements and STIGs.
  • Maintain technical documentation and collaborate with engineering teams.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Active DoD Secret clearance and U.S. citizenship.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related technical field with 4–8 years of relevant experience, or a master's degree with 2–6 years. Additional applicable experience may be considered in place of a degree.
  • DoD IAT Level II certification (Security+ or equivalent) and an approved Computing Environment (CE) certification.
  • Experience supporting network orchestration, automation, event management, or infrastructure engineering.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate with technical teams.
  • Flexibility to work nonstandard shifts and travel up to 10%.

Required Technologies & Technical Skills

  • Elastic: Experience with Elastic or comparable monitoring platforms.
  • ELK Stack: Familiarity with Elasticsearch, Logstash, and Kibana.
  • Linux/RHEL: Administration, configuration, and troubleshooting.
  • Network Monitoring: SNMPv3, network telemetry, and event management.
  • Containers: Kubernetes or container-based infrastructure.
  • Virtualization: VMware, KVM, or comparable technologies.
  • Network Management: Experience with at least one of Palo Alto Panorama, Cisco Prime, Cisco DNA, or Junos Space.
  • Network Automation: Orchestration workflows and infrastructure configuration management.
  • Networking: DNS, NTP, IDM, LAN/WAN, TCP/IP, routing, and switching.
  • Security: DoD STIGs and infrastructure hardening.

Preferred Qualifications & Technologies

  • CCNA, CCNP, Red Hat certification, or equivalent.

  • Knowledge of Git, GitLab CI/CD, Ansible, Terraform, Puppet, or Salt.

  • Experience with network migrations, data integration, and automation.
  • Experience mentoring junior engineers.

At Leidos, you'll help modernize the systems that monitor and secure the U.S. Army's global communications.

If you're a cleared engineer with Elastic, Linux, and network event management experience, we'd like to hear from you!

🚀Who We Are

vialytics is revolutionizing how cities manage road infrastructure. Our AI-powered road management system, combining intelligent software with a simple smartphone, enables municipalities to detect road damage, prioritize maintenance, and make smarter infrastructure decisions.

Founded in 2018, we have rapidly scaled across Europe and the U.S., supporting 900+ municipalities in 7 countries. Backed by a $10M Series A, vialytics is a fast-growing scale-up with ambitious international growth plans.

We are building our internal Data & Analytics function from nearly zero. You will set its strategy, operating model and team, and make trusted business data and AI agents part of how Finance, RevOps and leadership make decisions. You report directly to the CFO.

💼 Your Key Responsibilities

You will build vialytics' Data & Analytics function from nearly zero and own its impact on how Finance, RevOps and leadership make decisions.

Built Strategy and get stakeholders in

  • Agree a prioritised data strategy and roadmap with the CFO and business owners, and link every initiative to a specific business decision it should improve.

  • Turn Finance, RevOps and leadership questions into a short list of prioritised use cases, and decline requests that won't change a decision.

Establish trusted metrics

  • Establish core business metrics as a single source of truth, each with a clear definition, a named owner, quality checks and access rules.

  • Have business owners certify each metric before it is used in decisions or made available to AI tools.

Showcase delivery, AI and self-service

  • Deliver two or three high-value cross-functional milestones incrementally, shipping useful increments rather than one large platform project.

  • Within the first six months, pilot agent-supported workflows for the three most business-critical processes, with a named person accountable for each decision.

  • Pilot natural-language access to certified metrics for business users, with evaluation of answer accuracy, permissions and guardrails before any wider rollout.

  • Set up data and AI governance covering auditability, GDPR compliance and human certification of metrics.

Building a Team

  • Define the operating model and hiring sequence for Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, AI Engineering and embedded analysis, including when to hire central platform roles and when to embed analysts in business teams.

  • Build and lead the team as it grows, staying hands-on during the greenfield phase.

Showing Impact

  • Reduce ad hoc reporting effort and shorten decision turnaround. Set a baseline in the first quarter and measure both against it.

🌟 We would be the perfect match if you

  • 2-3 Years of leadership experience in data and analytics context

  • around 6 year similar experience building a function like this in a Scale-up environment between 100-400 employees in a fast growing SaaS business

  • Have built or substantially transformed a Data & Analytics function, and own its roadmap and prioritisation in a hands-on manner.

  • Understand semantic layers, single source of truth, BI and data platforms.

  • Have practical experience with agentic analytics, evaluation, access controls and AI governance.

  • Translate Finance, RevOps and leadership questions into measurable use cases.

  • Have experience with data ownership, data quality and GDPR-sensitive environments.

  • Can shape and hire a multi-disciplinary team remotely and work across business functions.

  • Are fluent in German and English (C1).

Nice to have:B2G or regulated environments, multi-region operations, hands-on analytics or data engineering, predictive or prescriptive analytics.

You do not need product computer-vision expertise, and you will not be expected to build every pipeline or semantic layer yourself.

🔀 Your Hiring Journey

  1. Kickoff chat:a friendly virtual chat with the Amelie of People & Culture to explore the practical aspects of the role and get a feel for our culture.

  2. Fit Conversation with Your Manager (60-90 min):Meet Oli, our CFO, to find out whether you and he are a good match and whether we would work well together.

  3. Showcase your skills (around 90 mins): meet Oli, CFO and other team members and present a practical case. That you will get in advance.

  4. Leadership interview (45 mins):meet the CPTO and other leaders on the C-suite for a discussion on business alignment, data strategy and how this role supports vialytics’ growth.

💰 What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation:A fair salary considering the complexity of the role.

  • Genuine greenfield mandate: build the strategy, team, architecture and operating model, with a direct reporting line to the CFO and exposure to business leadership.

  • Top-tier equipment and tools: MacBook, iPhone, AirPods, plus access to Google Workspace, Notion, Slack, Salesforce, Aircall and Microsoft 365.

  • A dynamic and multicultural scale-up environment: 10+ nationalities, flat hierarchy, and real impact from day one.

  • Perks and benefits: €1,500 per year training budget, EGYM Wellpass, FutureBens.

  • Offsites and events: regular in-person team gatherings and company-wide meetups.

Marketing Manager

Impact the Moment

Make an impact by bringing B2B marketing campaigns to life across North America, connecting professional medical and SciTech audiences with digital products that support their work, learning, and research.

As Marketing Manager, North America -B2B, you’ll play a hands-on role in executing integrated marketing campaigns, delivering impactful on-campus and field events, and supporting the Sales team to generate qualified leads and drive product awareness across the United States and Canada.

Working closely with the Associate Marketing Director (AMD), the Senior Marketing Manager, and the North America Sales team, you’ll turn campaign briefs into engaging, measurable marketing activity. From university roadshows and industry tradeshows to digital campaigns and targeted email programs, your work will help strengthen customer engagement, support new business development, and contribute to pipeline growth.

This is an execution-focused role where attention to detail, collaboration, and the ability to deliver at pace make a tangible difference to commercial success.

This role is remote position, and open to applicants authorized to work for any employer within the United States.

How You Can Make an Impact

  • You’ll bring energy, creativity, and precision to every campaign and activation, ensuring marketing plans translate into effective execution and measurable results.
  • Bringing campaigns to life: Delivering multi-channel B2B marketing campaigns that build awareness of our professional medical and SciTech digital products and engage the right audiences.
  • Connecting marketing with Sales: Working in close partnership with the North America Sales team to support priority accounts, deliver timely MQL handoffs, and equip Sales colleagues with the right messaging and collateral.
  • Creating meaningful field experiences: Executing engaging on-campus events, university roadshows, tradeshows, institutional open days, and professional association activities that strengthen customer relationships and uncover new opportunities.
  • Making data count: Tracking campaign performance, monitoring channel-level results, and providing accurate reporting that helps the AMD understand progress against agreed KPIs.
  • Delivering with agility: Managing multiple campaigns and events simultaneously, coordinating agencies and internal stakeholders, and ensuring activities are delivered on time and within budget.
  • Driving continuous improvement: Using campaign insights and performance data to identify opportunities for optimization and improve the effectiveness of future marketing activations.
  • Your success will be measured by the quality and timeliness of execution, the effectiveness of field and digital activity, the accuracy of campaign reporting, and your contribution to MQL pipeline generation and Sales support.

What You’ll Be Doing

Execute field and on-campus marketing events (30%)

  • Deliver field marketing events across the United States and Canada in partnership with the North America Sales team, including tradeshows, university roadshows, institutional open days, and professional association events.
  • Own the Sales-facing elements of event delivery, including messaging, pre-event briefings, stakeholder alignment, and post-event follow-up.
  • Work closely with the Event Manager, who supports event logistics, to deliver a seamless end-to-end event experience.
  • Support new business development and existing customer engagement through relevant, well-executed field activations.

Partner with Sales to support pipeline generation (25%)

  • Collaborate daily with the North America Sales team to align marketing execution with territory priorities, target accounts, and commercial objectives.
  • Attend regular Sales meetings to stay informed about account activity, upcoming opportunities, and campaign requirements.
  • Ensure timely and accurate MQL handoffs, supporting lead follow-up and providing relevant campaign collateral and activation materials.
  • Maintain clear communication with Sales on campaign timelines, event activity, lead status, and follow-up requirements.

Execute digital campaigns and manage agency activity (20%)

  • Build and activate multi-channel B2B campaigns across professional medical and SciTech digital product portfolios using Marketo.
  • Execute email programs, paid media campaigns, landing page updates, and digital content in line with briefs and timelines agreed with the AMD.
  • Coordinate with agency partners on paid media placements, UTM tracking, and campaign implementation.
  • Monitor digital campaign performance using Adobe Analytics or equivalent tools, reporting channel-level results against agreed KPIs and flagging optimization opportunities.

Maintain campaign data and performance reporting (10%)

  • Maintain accurate campaign, lead, and activity data in Marketo and Salesforce CRM.
  • Ensure marketing activities are correctly tagged and tracked to support reliable reporting and lead management.
  • Build and distribute regular campaign performance reports to support the AMD's reporting requirements and commercial planning.
  • Use Excel and analytics tools to interpret campaign results, identify trends, and provide clear, actionable performance insights.

Coordinate marketing assets and production (10%)

  • Coordinate the production of marketing assets with agencies and internal teams, including event collateral, digital creative, campaign content, and Sales enablement materials.
  • Manage agency and vendor relationships to support the timely delivery of campaigns and events.
  • Ensure all marketing materials follow global brand guidelines and meet agreed quality standards.
  • Track project timelines, deliverables, and expenditure to ensure activities are completed accurately, on time, and within budget.

Support budget and project delivery (5%)

  • Support the execution of the assigned North America marketing budget, maintaining accurate spend tracking.
  • Coordinate multiple campaign and event workstreams across product portfolios, managing priorities and deadlines effectively.
  • Identify creative opportunities to maximize the reach and impact of field marketing and event outreach.
  • Work collaboratively across teams, maintaining a customer-first approach and strong professional relationships.

What You’ll Need to Be Successful

  • 3–5 years of B2B marketing experience, ideally within education, healthcare, publishing, or a related sector.
  • Hands-on experience executing multi-channel marketing campaigns from brief through delivery.
  • Experience delivering field marketing events, on-campus activations, tradeshows, and other in-person marketing activities.
  • Practical experience using Marketo or an equivalent marketing automation platform (MAP) for campaign build, execution, and reporting.
  • Experience with Salesforce CRM for lead tracking, MQL management, and activity reporting is desirable.
  • Experience using Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, or equivalent tools to monitor and report on campaign performance.
  • Experience coordinating agencies, vendors, and internal stakeholders is an advantage.

Digital and technical skills

  • Proficiency in Marketo or an equivalent marketing automation platform.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce CRM and lead management processes.
  • Strong Excel skills, including data analysis, manipulation, and reporting.
  • Proficiency in PowerPoint and Microsoft Office.
  • Familiarity with project management tools such as Asana or equivalent platforms.
  • Confidence working with campaign tracking, analytics, and performance metrics.
  • AI fluency and an interest in leveraging AI agents and automated workflows to improve marketing execution and efficiency.

Skills and personal attributes

  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage campaigns and events.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to collaborate effectively across Marketing, Sales, agencies, and external partners.
  • A proactive, self-starter attitude, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability for execution.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a genuine curiosity for data and campaign performance.
  • Creativity and resourcefulness, with the ability to identify opportunities to maximize engagement and marketing impact.
  • A flexible, agile approach to managing competing priorities and changing requirements.
  • A customer-first mindset and a commitment to maintaining strong, professional relationships.
  • Educated to degree level or equivalent.

Why work for us?

At McGraw-Hill, we leverage cutting-edge technology to create innovative learning solutions that support learners at all stages of their educational journey. Our state-of-the-art digital tools and platforms provide personalized, interactive experiences that enhance understanding and retention. Being part of McGraw-Hill means joining a team dedicated to shaping the future of education and making a real impact on students' lives. It's an exciting opportunity to contribute to a company that values innovation, collaboration, and excellence.

The pay range for this position is between $82,000 - $107,000 USD annually, However, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location. An annual bonus plan may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical and/or other benefits, depending on the position offered.Click here to learn more about our benefit offerings.

About the Role

You’ll serve as the frontline voice of the business, helping customers resolve issues, answering questions, documenting interactions, and ensuring every customer receives a positive and professional experience.

This is a high-volume, customer-facing role where communication, responsiveness, problem-solving, and follow-through are essential.

If you enjoy helping people, communicate confidently, and stay calm and organized in fast-paced environments, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Customer Support & Issue Resolution

raw.title: Revenue Operations Manager
raw.excerpt: Join Revive Media to help advertisers across the country scale their localized Connected TV advertising.
raw.description:
Join Revive Media to help advertisers across the country scale their localized Connected TV advertising. Our business is growing rapidly and we're in the midst of transforming from a services agency to a product-led business with our new native platform, Convoy.

We are a small, remote-first team of high-performing professionals with diverse backgrounds located across many time zones, including North America, Europe, and Asia. We prioritize asynchronous communication and documentation but come together as a team to solve hard problems.


The Role

Revive is building its first true inbound and outbound go-to-market motion, and we need one person to own the data, process, and analysis that show how the revenue business is performing and where it can grow. You’ll be Revive’s first RevOps hire, reporting to the CRO as their right-hand data partner.

Today, nobody can see pipeline health, team performance against goals, retention by team, or margin in one place. You’ll fix that.

You’ll work side by side with our Head of Marketing. Marketing owns brand, positioning, ABM, content, lead scoring logic, and outbound outreach. You’ll own the data and reporting that make that work measurable, and the analysis that turns it into decisions.

The job has four parts: keep HubSpot data clean and trusted, track performance against goals, analyze the client base for growth, and own forecasting, margin, and ad hoc analysis.

What you'll own

1. HubSpot systems and hygiene (~30%)

  • Own HubSpot architecture: properties, pipelines, deal stages, workflows, permissions, and integrations
  • Build the plumbing marketing needs to run its lane: lead and lifecycle stages, scoring fields and workflows (marketing defines the model, you build and maintain it), lead routing, attribution properties, and the sync from Clay and sequencing tools into HubSpot
  • Define and enforce funnel definitions with the CRO and Head of Marketing: lead, MQL, meeting, opportunity, and closed-won
  • Run a weekly hygiene review across HubSpot: stale deals, missing amounts or close dates, deals in the wrong stage, unassigned records, and budget changes not reflected in booked revenue
  • Send automated reminders to owners when records fall out of compliance, and escalate repeat gaps to managers
  • Run recurring training sessions with the Account Strategy and sales teams so everyone knows how to log activity, update deals, and use reports
  • Connect HubSpot to Convoy and Redshift so bookings and spend tie back to pipeline
  • Document processes and keep a single source of truth for how we use our tools

2. Performance and goal tracking (~25%)

  • Build and maintain scorecards for every role against their quarterly goals: Account Leads, Account Managers, sales, and channel partner teams
  • Automate goal tracking that is manual today: meetings (new vs. existing), proposals, pipeline created, bookings, upsell, and AMC adoption
  • Send the CRO a weekly recap of how each person and pod is tracking, with clear flags on who is ahead, who is behind, and why
  • Run bonus and incentive tracking so grading is consistent, auditable, and easy to explain
  • Give managers the data to coach, improve the team, and make exits with evidence

3. Client base and growth analysis (~25%)

  • Measure retention and churn by account, owner, pod, channel partner, and vertical
  • Flag at-risk accounts early using spend trends, pacing, and engagement signals
  • Find upsell and cross-sell opportunities: accounts underpenetrated on products like Prime Video, STV, Netflix, AMC, and Signal, and brands we could add within agencies we already serve
  • Track AMC adoption across the team and accounts, and show where the gaps are
  • Turn findings into clear talking points for the CRO on where the business can grow, for leadership updates, QBRs, and partner conversations

4. Forecasting, margin, and special projects (~20%)

  • Own the revenue forecast: build forward projections by pod, channel, and product, and track forecast accuracy over time
  • Build leading indicators the CRO can pull quickly: new deal count, opportunity value over trailing 30 and 60 days, and spend vs. booked variance
  • Track gross and net margin by pod, partner, account, and product, including partner rev share and platform fees
  • Support platform partnerships with data: Amazon, Netflix, and other partner spend forecasts, joint business plan inputs, and commitment tracking
  • Take on ad hoc analysis when a question comes up, get into the data, and come back with a clear answer and a recommendation

Requirements

  • Four or more years in RevOps, sales ops, or revenue analytics at a B2B company, ideally as the first or only ops hire
  • Deep HubSpot admin experience: you've rebuilt a messy instance, not just inherited a clean one
  • Strong SQL and data modeling skills; comfortable pulling from a data warehouse such as Redshift and building in a BI tool
  • Experience building forecasts and tracking forecast accuracy
  • Comfortable with APIs, webhooks, and automation tools such as Zapier, Make, or n8n
  • You turn messy data into a clear weekly story a CRO can act on
  • Builder mindset: you ship a working v1 fast, then improve it

Nice to have

  • Ad tech, programmatic, or agency experience, especially Amazon DSP or AMC
  • Experience with margin and unit economics analysis in a rev share or fee-based business
  • Experience with AI tools to automate reporting and analysis
  • Python or scripting experience
  • Experience setting up comp, quota, or bonus tracking

Benefits

  • Comprehensive healthcare including medical, vision & dental benefits covered at 100% for employees and 50% for dependents
  • We're fully remote and offer a remote working stipend
  • Flexible PTO - take what you need, when you need
  • Coffee or Tea Subscription
  • Monthly 3 day weekend

Revive Media provides the wage it reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for all remote roles and as otherwise required by applicable law. The expected base pay for this role is $130k-$150k, with a quarterly bonus + equity. Actual compensation may vary within the listed range based on a wide array of factors, including, but not limited to, skill set, experience, and specific geographic location.

Revive Media is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We assess all qualified candidates on the basis of skill, experience and talent.

raw.description:
Job Title: Data Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. client business hours (with flexibility for pipeline monitoring, deployments, and data refresh cycles)

About the Role

Our client is seeking a Data Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable data infrastructure and reliable data pipelines that power analytics, reporting, and operational decision-making across the business.

This role requires strong software engineering fundamentals, deep experience with modern data stacks, and a passion for building clean, reliable, and high-performance data systems. The Data Engineer will ensure data flows seamlessly from source systems into warehouses, dashboards, and downstream applications while maintaining high standards for quality, governance, and scalability.

The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working across engineering, analytics, and business teams to deliver trustworthy and actionable data.

Responsibilities

Pipeline Development & Data Integration

  • Build, maintain, and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, SQL, or Scala
    • Orchestrate workflows using Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, or similar orchestration tools
    • Ingest structured and unstructured data from APIs, SaaS platforms, databases, files, and streaming systems
    • Develop scalable connectors and automated ingestion workflows

Data Warehousing & Modeling

  • Manage and optimize cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift
    • Design scalable schemas using star and snowflake modeling techniques
    • Implement partitioning, clustering, indexing, and performance optimization strategies
    • Build clean, analytics-ready datasets for business intelligence and reporting use cases

Data Quality, Governance & Reliability

  • Implement validation checks, anomaly detection, logging, and monitoring to ensure data integrity
    • Enforce naming conventions, lineage tracking, and documentation standards using tools such as dbt or Great Expectations
    • Maintain audit-ready data processes and ensure compliance with GDPR, HIPAA, or industry-specific requirements
    • Monitor pipeline health and proactively resolve failures or inconsistencies

Streaming & Real-Time Data Processing

  • Build and manage real-time data pipelines using Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub, or similar platforms
    • Support low-latency ingestion and event-driven architectures for time-sensitive applications
    • Monitor streaming infrastructure and optimize throughput and reliability

Collaboration & Analytics Enablement

  • Partner closely with analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable datasets
    • Support dashboard and reporting initiatives across Tableau, Looker, or Power BI
    • Translate business requirements into scalable data solutions and models
    • Maintain clear technical documentation for pipelines, schemas, and workflows

Infrastructure, DevOps & Automation

  • Containerize data services using Docker and manage deployments through Kubernetes when applicable
    • Automate deployments using CI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI
    • Manage cloud infrastructure using Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar Infrastructure-as-Code tools
    • Continuously optimize performance, scalability, reliability, and cloud costs

What Makes You a Perfect Fit

  • Passionate about building clean, reliable, and scalable data systems
    • Strong debugging and problem-solving mindset with high attention to detail
    • Balance of software engineering discipline and analytical thinking
    • Comfortable working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical stakeholders
    • Proactive communicator who takes ownership of data quality and reliability

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Back-End Engineering, or Data Infrastructure roles

• Strong proficiency in Python and SQL

  • Experience with at least one modern data warehouse (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery)
    • Hands-on experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow or Prefect
    • Strong understanding of ETL/ELT pipelines, data modeling, and data transformation workflows
    • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure

Preferred Experience & Skills

  • Experience with dbt for data modeling and transformation management
    • Streaming and event-driven data pipeline experience (Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub)
    • Experience with cloud-native data services such as AWS Glue, GCP Dataflow, or Azure Data Factory
    • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, or CI/CD workflows
    • Background in regulated industries such as healthcare, fintech, or enterprise SaaS
    • Experience optimizing warehouse costs and query performance at scale

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

A Data Engineer’s day revolves around maintaining reliable pipelines, improving data quality, and enabling teams with scalable access to trustworthy data. You will:

  • Monitor pipeline health and troubleshoot failed jobs in Airflow or related orchestration systems
    • Build and maintain ingestion pipelines for APIs, SaaS platforms, and operational databases
    • Optimize SQL queries and warehouse performance to improve efficiency and reduce cloud costs
    • Collaborate with analysts and data scientists to provide curated datasets for reporting and modeling
    • Implement validation checks and monitoring to prevent downstream data quality issues
    • Document data models, transformations, and workflows to ensure scalability and maintainability

In essence: you ensure the organization has accurate, timely, and reliable data powering operational, analytical, and strategic decisions.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

• Pipeline uptime ≥ 99%

  • Data freshness maintained within agreed SLAs

raw.description:
Are you an active researcher with broad interests in plant ecology?

Salary: c. £7,900 per annum, which equates to approximately €9,150 or US$10,800
Contract: 3-year contract
Location: at the holder’s host university or organisation, based anywhere in the world
Closing date: Friday 15 January 2027
Interview date: January or February 2027 TBC, via Microsoft Teams

About the Journal

Journal of Ecology is a renowned British Ecological Society journal that publishes original research papers on all aspects of the ecology of plants (including algae), in both aquatic and terrestrial ecosystems.

Journal of Ecology publishes high-quality, influential papers where plant ecology is central. We welcome studies of the role of plants in aquatic and terrestrial ecosystems, and the interactions of plants with animals, fungi or bacteria. Journal of Ecology was established over 100 years ago as the foundation publication of British Ecological Society and has become the Society’s flagship outlet for research focused on plant ecology.

The journal has a wide international audience, an active social media presence with over 33,000 followers on Twitter and a dedicated journal blog, and excellent publication metrics including a current Impact Factor of 5.6, and a CiteScore of 11.4.

The Journal’s editorial team consists of five Editors who are supported by dedicated editorial office personnel and an international board of around 100 Associate Editors. The Senior Editors work together to determine journal strategy and to increase the reputation and quality of the Journal, in addition to making decisions on around 1300 manuscripts submitted each year. Further details about the Journal and its current editorial team can be found here.

Requirements

About you

We are seeking an Editor to strengthen and complement the editorial team and to continue raising the Journal’s profile worldwide.

To complement our Editor team, we are looking for an active researcher broad interests in plant ecology. Expertise in remote sensing, trophic networks, aquatic ecology or plant physiology is particularly welcomed but not required.

Applications are welcome from leading scientists covering any areas of the Journal’s scope who could contribute to the Journal’s development in topical and developing fields.

The ideal candidate will be a clear communicator who works well as part of a team and a good decision-maker who acts with integrity in both their editorial and own scientific work. They will be a creative thinker, with a solid understanding of their own field of plant ecology, as well as an overview of the wider discipline; experience of reviewing and editing processes; commitment to maintaining the high editorial standards of the Journal; and an interest in ongoing developments within academic publishing.

About the role

We are seeking an ecologist who is highly motivated in publishing excellent plant ecology to join the team of Editors of Journal of Ecology.

Working with other members of the Journal team to promote the aims of the Journal, commission and evaluate submissions, and plan and implement strategies that will enhance its profile, expand its reach, and better serve its community of authors and readers.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assess submitted manuscripts for suitability, selecting handling Associate Editors and reviewers, and making decisions based on their comments and your own judgement
  • Actively promote the Journal and the BES to your networks and when attending conferences
  • Solicit contributions in all areas relevant to the Journal
  • Identify key subject areas on which the Journal should focus
  • Gather opinions from fellow academic ecologists: use this information to suggest changes in procedure, to develop new initiatives and/or to feed into general discussions about the strategic direction of the Journal
  • Identify and recruit new Associate Editors, including through the promotion of open recruitment calls, with a focus on ensuring diverse representation and participation amongst editorial board members
  • Assist the editorial office team to identify papers for further promotion via blogs, video, podcasting and the media
  • Contribute to the Journal’s development and join in discussions with those involved with other BES journals to help identify opportunities for cross-journal initiatives
  • Act as Associate Editor for a limited number of manuscripts
  • Actively engage with social media tools in order to help promote the Journal (desirable)

Selection criteria:

  • Evidence of an active and relevant publication record
  • Knowledge and understanding of the subject area, complementary to that of the existing Editors
  • Experience of reviewing (essential) and of other editorial work (highly desirable)
  • Ability to work as part of a team of Editors, thinking both strategically and creatively
  • Ability to work independently and to prioritise from a range of active projects
  • Ability to form, communicate with, and operate in, scientific networks and engage with other relevant audiences, including through use of social media
  • Ability to consider multiple information sources or viewpoints, and act decisively
  • Commitment to the post and to the mission of the BES, and a desire to explore new opportunities to develop and enhance journal publishing

The Journal recognises the benefits that a diverse editorial board brings. We strongly encourage leading ecologists from underrepresented demographic groups and geographic regions to apply.

This post is a part-time three-year contract (current honorarium c. £7,900 per annum, which equates to approximately €9,150 or US$10,800) and located at the holder’s host university or organisation, based anywhere in the world. Some additional financial support is available to facilitate attendance at meetings with other BES Editors and to act as an ambassador for the Journal at relevant conferences.

Consultant (Associate Track)

About LunchAssist

LunchAssist supports school nutrition leaders by simplifying compliance, strengthening programs, and providing high-quality training and tools. We work with 500+ school districts and operate at the intersection of school nutrition, compliance, and technology. We are a growing, California-certified, small, woman-owned business staffed by a badass team of school nutrition neRDs.

We provide consulting to school districts in California, advising across all areas of the School Nutrition Program (SNP) and the Child and Adult Care Food Program (CACFP). We also offer training to school districts nationwide through online courses, live webinars, bilingual training videos, resources, and a proprietary software called LunchAssist PRO, which meets USDA professional standards and training requirements.

Overview

This role is designed for individuals who are ready to become high-impact consultants in school nutrition. At LunchAssist, consulting goes beyond technical expertise. Members of our team learn how to translate knowledge into clear guidance, training, and problem-solving across diverse districts. We provide accurate guidance to nutrition directors that is actually useful. Our clients come to us because we cut through government jargon and help them apply program regulations in ways that make sense for their operations and mitigate the risk of compliance issues down the road.

Our virtual workplace is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and impact-oriented. Successful candidates will bring strong experience in school nutrition programs, along with the humility to understand that consulting requires a distinct professional skill set. New hires will learn how to translate their expertise into effective client advisory, training, and problem-solving across all areas of the SNP and CACFP.

Associate Track

All new consultants enter a structured development period similar to supervised practice in a new specialty. New hires join a collaborative consulting pod where they immediately contribute by executing key components of client work. New hires will spend 12-18 months on this “Associate Track”, eventually building the confidence and skills to lead client relationships.

The Associate Track is designed to build:

  • Client advisory and communication skills
  • Problem-solving across varied district environments
  • Technical depth and breadth of knowledge across all SNP and CACFP program areas
  • Confidence and good judgment required for independent client management

During the first 12-18 months, new consultants on the Associate Track will support clients by:

  • Drafting client communications and follow-ups
  • Preparing action items from meetings and compliance documentation
  • Supporting menu planning, nutrient analysis, and crediting of recipes
  • Supporting SNP/CACFP Administrative and Procurement Reviews
  • Assisting with special projects, resource management tools, and state reporting
  • Contributing to both strategy and execution
  • Providing coverage to more experienced consultants when they are on leave

At LunchAssist, we are committed to building a team of school nutrition consultants who combine a wide breadth of programmatic knowledge, deep subject-matter expertise, and high-trust client advisory skills. We believe that great consultants are developed through guided, hands-on practice and peer-to-peer mentorship, not just prior experience in school nutrition.

Over time, consultants assume increasing responsibility, including leading portions of client interactions and progressing toward full client management.

Consulting at LunchAssist is both strategic and hands-on.

All consultants:

  • Operate within pods and contribute to shared delivery
  • Engage in both execution and advisory work
  • Maintain a balance of client work and internal contributions

In addition to client work, consultants contribute to internal priorities such as:

  • Developing training materials and resources
  • Supporting webinars and conferences
  • Improving tools, systems, and content

This work is a core component of the role and supports scalability across the organization.

As consultants progress, responsibilities include:

  • Supporting and leading client meetings (primarily via Zoom)
  • Advising school nutrition directors on USDA and State requirements (CDE)
  • Preparing clients for Administrative and Procurement Reviews
  • Contributing to projects (e.g., CEP/P2, bids and procurement, farm-to-school)
  • Developing training materials, tools, and resources
  • Speaking at webinars and conferences
  • Supporting and mentoring new consultants

Requirements

Must Have:

  • Bachelor's Degree
  • Registered Dietitian and/or previous employment by a State Agency conducting SNP Administrative Reviews
  • 5+ years of experience in school nutrition (district, State, or USDA)
  • Strong menu planning and compliance experience
  • Strong communication skills (with an emphasis on digital communications such as Zoom & email)
  • Demonstrated problem-solving ability and attention to detail
  • Organized, adaptable, collaborative, resourceful, and humble

Preferred:

  • Native or fluent Spanish proficiency, with the ability to deliver training and consulting in Spanish

Who Thrives in This Role:

  • Growth-oriented individuals interested in consulting and who enjoy detailed, hands-on work
  • School nutrition professionals who value both strategy and execution
  • Strong communicators who build trust with clients and connect well with school nutrition leaders

Compensation

The salary range for this role is $75,000-$100,000. We typically start at the bottom of the range, and new hires have the opportunity for rapid salary growth based on performance and business needs.

Benefits

  • 15 vacation days, 14 holidays, 8 sick days
  • 401(k) with 4% match (immediate vesting)
  • Medical, dental, vision, short-term disability, and life insurance
  • $100/month home office stipend

Schedule & Work Environment

  • Full-time, exempt, remote (must provide home office set up, including computer)
  • Must be able to travel 10% of the time for conferences, in-person client meetings, or trainings
  • Availability required until 5:30 p.m. Pacific Time (prefer candidates located in the Western U.S.)

Apply

Please submit an application via Breezy HR. Due to high application volume, not all applicants will receive a response. Selected candidates will be contacted for interviews.
Salary: $75,000 – $100,000 / year

raw.description:
Responsibilities, authorities and accountabilities

  • Support the SP&S Controller in maintaining an effective controllership framework for the Services and WCS portfolio, helping identify and mitigate accounting, financial, and operational control risks.
  • Partner with Business Operations, Finance, and Controllership teams to ensure transactions are appropriately accounted for and compliant with US GAAP, company accounting policies, and internal control requirements.
  • Ensure effective PMR governance for newbuild equipment, maintaining a strong control framework, consistent application of the relevant policy, and appropriate financial oversight.
  • Conduct Revenue Recognition training for Finance and Operations.
  • Support the monthly and quarterly financial closing and reporting processes, including the review of financial results, accounting entries, and significant or unusual transactions.
  • Perform and support balance sheet reviews, helping ensure account reconciliations, supporting documentation, and corrective actions are completed accurately and on time.
  • Monitor asset quality and working capital, including past-due receivables, inventory exposure, obsolescence, accruals, provisions, and other relevant balance sheet items.
  • Support bad debt and credit risk reviews, working with the relevant Finance and Commercial teams to identify exposures and ensure appropriate accounting treatment.
  • Work with accounting shared service organizations on account reconciliations, general ledger activities, closing processes, and issue resolution.
  • Support the SP&S Controller in Controllership operating rhythms such as quarterly pre-close reviews, closing reviews, balance sheet reviews, Key Account Reviews, and other controllership initiatives.
  • Support the review of complex or non-routine transactions, performing initial accounting analysis and escalating significant matters to Technical Controllership when appropriate.
  • Monitor key controllership metrics and open actions for the Services and WCS portfolio and follow up with responsible stakeholders to ensure timely closure.
  • Support SOX controls, internal audits, and external audit requirements, including the preparation and coordination of supporting documentation and the follow-up of remediation actions.
  • Partner with Finance, Operations, and other functions to improve financial processes, reporting quality, and internal controls, supporting simplification and standardization initiatives.
  • Support the implementation of changes in accounting policies, processes, and financial systems within the Services and WCS portfolio.
  • Support ad hoc controllership analyses and projects.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in Finance, Accounting, Controllership, Audit, or a related financial role.
  • Experience in managing revenue recognition for businesses providing services, upgrades, and repairs of customer-owned assets, as well as non-customized equipment and spare parts.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel and financial reporting/accounting systems.

Desired Characteristics

  • Good understanding of financial reporting, accounting principles, and internal controls.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Knowledge of US GAAP and financial accounting principles.
  • Ability to work effectively with Finance, Operations, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Attention to detail, with the ability to identify accounting or financial control issues.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver against closing and reporting deadlines.
  • Proactive approach to issue resolution and process improvement.
  • Comfortable working in a matrixed, international organization.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Willingness to develop broader technical accounting and controllership capabilities.

You will be eligible to participate in Company-sponsored benefit programs, including health & welfare programs and the Thrift Plan (401k). You will have a choice of coverage options that best suit your needs. Coverage options and contribution amounts are related to your benefit elections, base salary level, and specific requirements of each of these plans.

This position is eligible for our comprehensive and competitive benefits package, which can be found here, and is further eligible for additional forms of compensation such as bonuses subject to the terms of the applicable benefit plans or policies.

The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Finance Senior Team leader - Accounting Operations

raw.description:
Position Summary

The Business Operations Manager helps teams work more effectively by managing essential operational activities, improving business processes, and strengthening the tools and information that support day-to-day work. This hands-on individual contributor takes ownership of assigned responsibilities, coordinates across teams, and turns operational challenges into practical, sustainable solutions.

The role combines operational execution with project management, process improvement, systems optimization, automation, and performance reporting. The ideal candidate brings strong attention to detail, sound judgment, curiosity, and the ability to move comfortably between solving immediate problems and building better ways of working.

The base annual salary for this position is $90,000-$125,000 and will be commensurate with the candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, and skills.

Key Responsibilities

Operational Execution & Coordination

  • Own assigned operational activities and projects, ensuring that work is completed accurately, consistently, and on time.
  • Coordinate complex cross-functional initiatives from planning through execution, establishing clear objectives, responsibilities, timelines, and next steps.
  • Work with stakeholders to clarify needs, manage dependencies, remove obstacles, and keep work moving across teams.
  • Investigate operational issues, establish practical quality controls and escalation paths, and reduce recurring errors or delays.

Process Improvement & Enablement

  • Identify inefficient or inconsistent practices, investigate root causes, and work with stakeholders to prioritize meaningful improvements.
  • Develop and implement clear processes, standard operating procedures, playbooks, checklists, and templates that make work easier to execute and scale.
  • Organize and maintain accessible operational documentation and knowledge resources; help teams understand and adopt updated ways of working.
  • Assess whether improvements are achieving the intended results and adjust approaches based on performance data and feedback.

Business Systems & Automation

  • Improve the way teams use business applications by maintaining workflows, making appropriate configuration changes, and troubleshooting workflow and configuration issues.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to automate repetitive work, including appropriate use of AI and low-code tools, to improve speed, accuracy, and capacity.
  • Collaborate with business and technical partners to turn operational needs into system enhancements, coordinate changes, and test solutions before rollout.
  • Support accurate operational records, clear system procedures, and consistent use of tools across teams.

Operational Performance & Reporting

  • Work with stakeholders to establish and monitor useful measures of operational performance, such as timeliness, quality, efficiency, and adherence to established processes.
  • Maintain and improve operational reports and dashboards, collaborating with data or technical specialists when more advanced support is needed.
  • Analyze data and workflow performance to identify trends, recurring problems, and opportunities for action.
  • Track the outcomes of operational improvements, communicate findings, and recommend further refinements.

Requirements

Required

  • 5+ years of experience in business operations, program operations, process improvement, project management, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated ownership of cross-functional operational projects, including planning, managing dependencies, resolving issues, and delivering results independently.
  • Hands-on experience configuring or improving business systems, including forms, fields, workflows, or automated tasks - not simply using software as an end user.
  • Demonstrated success improving processes from root-cause analysis and solution design through implementation, adoption, and measurable results.
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills (including lookups and pivot tables), with the ability to analyze dashboards and operational data to identify issues and recommend action.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, documentation, organization, attention to detail, and stakeholder coordination skills.

Preferred

  • Experience using ChatGPT, Claude, Atlassian Rovo, or comparable AI tools beyond one-off prompting to build reusable assistants or agents, integrate AI into repeatable operational workflows, and validate outputs.
  • Experience building or maintaining workflow automations using Jira Automation, Slack workflows, HubSpot workflows, Google Workspace, or comparable tools.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, HubSpot, or comparable project management, knowledge management, and CRM platforms - including workflow configuration, documentation, data quality, or reporting.
  • Experience creating or improving dashboards in Amazon QuickSight or comparable BI tools (such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker) - including visualizations, filters, and calculated fields.
  • Familiarity with structured improvement methods and mindsets such as Lean Six Sigma and Agile.

Role Scope & Collaboration

This is a hands-on individual contributor role within Business Operations, working with leaders and teams across the organization. The Operations Manager owns assigned operational responsibilities and improvement initiatives, collaborates with functional and technical partners as needed, and is accountable for practical execution and results. The role does not include direct people management, and its focus may evolve with business priorities.

Benefits

  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
  • Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
  • Short Term & Long Term Disability
  • Work From Home
  • Wellness Resources

Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

Overview

The HR Operations Manager leads the day-to-day operational delivery of the HR function, ensuring compliant, consistent and high-quality people services across the organisation. Reporting to the HR Director, this role is accountable for the full employee lifecycle, payroll and benefits oversight employee relations delivery, HR systems, data integrity, and continuous process improvement. A key differentiator for this role is the ability to harness data, analytics and emerging technologies — including AI-driven tools — to elevate HR service quality, drive automation, and surface actionable workforce insight that supports strategic decision-making.

This position is newly created as part of MWI UK and Nordic’s divestment from Cencora, and will be critical in supporting the new business post sale completion. The successful candidate will join at a pivotal moment, with the first 12 months carrying a particular focus on HR workstreams associated with Transition Services Agreement (TSA) disentanglement, standalone HR readiness, and the adoption of AI-enabled HR workflows as the new organisation builds a modern and scalable people function. The role is ideally suited to a candidate within commutable distance of MWI's UK headquarters in Castle Cary, though primarily remote candidates who are able to travel to the office a few times per month will also be considered.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Governance

  • Lead, develop and performance-manage the HR Operations team (Employee Relations Partner, Payroll & Benefits Lead, HR Coordinator).
  • Own HR operational governance, service standards and KPI frameworks.
  • Establish and monitor HR service level agreements, ensuring consistent, high-quality delivery to employees and managers.
  • Identify and proactively manage operational HR risks.
  • Support the HR Director with HR reporting, board-level governance packs and people analytics.

Employee Lifecycle & Administration

  • Ensure effective, compliant and timely end-to-end employee lifecycle processes (onboarding, changes, offboarding).
  • Oversee HR administration and recruitment coordination, maintaining accuracy and speed of service.
  • Maintain and regularly review HR policies and procedures in line with employment legislation and best practice.

Payroll, Benefits & Employee Relations

  • Oversee payroll and benefits delivery, ensuring accuracy, compliance and a positive employee experience.
  • Oversee ER service delivery, supporting fair, consistent and legally compliant case management.
  • Ensure compliance with all relevant employment legislation and people-related regulatory requirements.
  • Train managers, in collaboration with the HRBP to ensure best practice through people leaders.

HR Systems, Data & AI Capability

  • Own HR data integrity, ensuring records are accurate, complete and audit-ready at all times.
  • Lead the management and continuous optimisation of HR systems (HRIS, ATS etc)
  • Champion the use of data and people analytics to monitor operational performance and surface HR insight.
  • Identify and implement AI-enabled tools and automation to streamline HR processes, reduce manual effort and improve employee experience.
  • Build data literacy within the HR team, embedding a culture of evidence-based decision-making.
  • Partner with IT and digital teams to evaluate and deploy HR technology solutions aligned to the People Strategy.

Continuous Improvement

  • Continuously identify and deliver improvements to HR processes, systems and employee/manager experience.
  • Lead process re-engineering initiatives, leveraging automation and AI where appropriate.
  • Contribute operational insight to the development and execution of the broader People Strategy.

.

Qualifications

Experience

  • General HR experience in a multi-site or complex organisation.
  • Proven track record of leading an HR Operations team and managing all aspects of employee life cycle and varied ER case work.
  • Experience working in a unionised environment.
  • Experience introducing, managing and optimising HR systems
  • Demonstrated experience using people data and analytics to drive operational insight and decision-making.
  • Exposure to AI-enabled HR tools, process automation or digital transformation projects is highly desirable.
  • Experience operating in a regulated or compliance-intensive environment preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Strong working knowledge of employment law and HR compliance frameworks.
  • Proficiency in HR information systems and payroll platforms.
  • Confident data analyst — able to build, interpret and present HR dashboards and reports.
  • Familiarity, or competence, with AI tools, automation platform and their application in HR.
  • Competent in Microsoft 365, including Excel and Power BI or equivalent reporting tools.

Attributes

  • Operationally excellent with a strong eye for detail and process rigour.
  • Digitally curious — passionate about technology, data and the future of HR.
  • A collaborative team leader who develops capability in others.
  • Commercially minded with the ability to connect HR operations to business outcomes.
  • Resilient, solutions-focused and comfortable managing competing priorities.
  • Strong communicator and relationship builder across all levels of the organisation.

Qualifications

  • CIPD Level 5 qualified;
  • Or, relevant equivalent experience

What Cencora offers

​Benefit offerings outside the US may vary by country and will be aligned to local market practice. The eligibility and effective date may differ for some benefits and for team members covered under collective bargaining agreements.
