raw.description:
Sales Account Executive (B2B Sales & Full-Cycle Closing) – Remote | EST Hours

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Eastern Time (EST)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Sales Account Executive to drive new business, manage the full B2B sales cycle, and build strong client relationships.

This is a hands-on, full-cycle sales role for someone who can take an opportunity from initial outreach through signed agreement.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Prospecting and generating new business
  • Running discovery calls and sales presentations
  • Managing opportunities through the pipeline
  • Negotiating and closing deals
  • Building long-term client relationships
  • Consistently achieving revenue targets

If you have a proven sales track record, communicate confidently with decision-makers, and enjoy owning revenue outcomes, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Full-Cycle B2B Sales

Own the complete sales process from prospecting through close:

  • Prospecting
  • Outreach
  • Qualification
  • Discovery calls
  • Sales presentations
  • Follow-up
  • Negotiation
  • Closing

Identify new business opportunities and maintain consistent activity across every stage of the sales funnel.

Pipeline Generation & Management

  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities.
  • Generate new business through proactive prospecting and follow-up.
  • Prioritize opportunities based on fit, intent, and revenue potential.
  • Maintain strong follow-up discipline to keep deals moving.
  • Track pipeline activity, next steps, and expected close dates.

Discovery & Consultative Selling

  • Conduct structured discovery calls with prospective clients.
  • Understand business needs, pain points, priorities, and buying motivations.
  • Ask thoughtful questions to identify the right solution.
  • Tailor sales conversations and presentations to each prospect.
  • Communicate business value clearly rather than relying on feature-based selling.

Sales Presentations & Closing

  • Deliver professional sales presentations and solution recommendations.
  • Build credibility with business owners and decision-makers.
  • Handle objections confidently and professionally.
  • Negotiate pricing and commercial terms within approved guidelines.
  • Drive qualified opportunities toward clear decisions and successful closes.

Client Relationship Management

  • Build strong relationships with prospects and clients.
  • Maintain professional communication throughout the sales process.
  • Understand client goals and recommend appropriate solutions.
  • Support smooth transitions after the sale.
  • Identify opportunities for repeat business, referrals, or account growth where applicable.

CRM & Sales Reporting

Maintain accurate CRM records covering:

  • Prospect interactions
  • Sales activities
  • Pipeline stages
  • Follow-ups
  • Deal values
  • Next steps
  • Expected close dates

Provide leadership with clear visibility into pipeline health, sales activity, and revenue opportunities.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with internal teams to:

  • Ensure smooth client handoffs after closing.
  • Communicate customer expectations accurately.
  • Share prospect and market feedback.
  • Support broader sales and revenue goals.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the sales process.

Required Experience & Skills

Must-Have

  • 3+ years of experience in Sales, Account Management, Business Development, or a related revenue-generating role.
  • Proven ability to close deals and achieve revenue targets.
  • Experience managing the full sales cycle.
  • Strong pipeline management and follow-up discipline.
  • Experience using CRM systems.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication.
  • Strong negotiation and objection-handling skills.
  • Ability to build relationships with business owners and decision-makers.
  • Self-motivated, competitive, and results-oriented.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • Availability to work EST hours.

Nice-to-Have Experience

  • B2B sales experience.
  • Service-based sales experience.
  • Experience selling to business owners or senior decision-makers.
  • Remote sales experience.
  • Experience generating your own pipeline.
  • Consultative or solution-selling experience.
  • Strong forecasting and reporting skills.
  • Stable employment history with demonstrated career progression.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Enjoy both prospecting and closing.
  • Are confident leading sales conversations.
  • Know how to uncover a prospect’s actual business needs.
  • Build relationships without losing focus on revenue outcomes.
  • Follow up consistently and keep opportunities moving.
  • Are comfortable handling objections and negotiating.
  • Think in terms of pipeline, conversion, and revenue.
  • Take ownership of your targets rather than waiting for opportunities to come to you.
  • Thrive in fast-paced, performance-driven environments.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

A Sales Account Executive’s day may include:

  • Prospecting for new business opportunities.
  • Following up with active leads.
  • Running discovery calls.
  • Delivering sales presentations.
  • Speaking with business owners and decision-makers.
  • Handling objections and negotiating deals.
  • Moving opportunities through pipeline stages.
  • Updating CRM records and next steps.
  • Reviewing pipeline health and sales performance.
  • Coordinating internally on newly closed clients.

In short: you build pipeline, develop relationships, close deals, and directly drive revenue growth.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Monthly and quarterly revenue generated
  • Sales quota attainment
  • Qualified pipeline generated
  • Lead-to-opportunity conversion rate
  • Opportunity-to-close conversion rate
  • Number and value of deals closed
  • Pipeline health and deal velocity
  • CRM accuracy and reporting discipline
  • Client relationship quality and retention

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Fully remote opportunity.
  • Full ownership of the sales cycle.
  • Direct impact on company revenue.
  • Opportunity to work closely with leadership.
  • Performance-driven environment with strong earning potential.
  • High autonomy and ownership.
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Account Executive
    • Enterprise Account Executive
    • Sales Manager
    • Business Development Manager
    • Sales Leadership

Interview Process

  • Initial Screening Call
  • Recruiter Interview
  • Final Client Interview
  • Background Verification
  • Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Intro Video

As part of the application process, you’ll be asked to complete a short Spark Hire intro video.

We’re particularly interested in hearing about:

  • Your B2B sales experience.
  • The products or services you’ve sold.
  • Your experience owning the full sales cycle.
  • How you generate and manage pipeline.
  • Your approach to discovery, objection handling, and closing.
  • Your track record against sales or revenue targets.
  • An example of a deal you successfully moved from initial conversation through close.

Keep your responses clear, concise, and conversational. We want to understand how you communicate with prospects, build relationships, and approach sales opportunities.

Completion of the Spark Hire intro video is required for your application to be considered.

Apply Now

If you:

  • Have 3+ years of sales experience.
  • Have a proven ability to close deals and hit targets.
  • Enjoy full-cycle B2B sales.
  • Are confident communicating with decision-makers.
  • Take ownership of pipeline and revenue.
  • Thrive in target-driven environments.

We’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and complete the required Spark Hire intro video to move forward in the hiring process.

At Epiq, your work contributes to complex, global legal outcomes. You’ll join a values‑driven community where integrity guides decisions, relentless service sets the bar, and we thrive on big challenges together. We invest in your growth with enterprise‑wide learning and mobility. We celebrate who you are, and we respect life beyond work with flexibility that’s recognized externally. Enabled by modern platforms and AI, you’ll do the most meaningful work of your career and see your impact at scale.

Job Description:

Job Summary:

The Associate Project Manager will serve to assist senior Client Services peers through effective project management coordination and execution, as part of the Client Services Global Resourcing Team of individuals serving North America clients from other geographies. Successful candidates will have relevant experience in service delivery, preferably in eDiscovery, as well as a proven history of execution in a fast-paced environment.


The Associate Project Manager is primarily responsible for making sure the client receives the proper service through proactive attention to planning, analysis, execution, and proper close-out on a project. The Associate Project Manager is responsible for the day-to-day execution of the project including providing the client and their internal project teams with clear direction, according to the client’s requirements and company standards.


Essential Job Responsibilities

  • Ensures client and project requirements are being met with the highest quality and accuracy through verifying and communicating routinely with both the client and internal partners.
  • Converts client requirements into operational work requests, monitor progress, and proactively updates client and project team stakeholders on deadlines.
  • Obtain, examine and prepare client data for Intake
  • Assist in troubleshooting and resolving any client issues with delivered or hosted data
  • Handle review platform (DMX or Relativity) specific items including but not limited to User requests, database management (archiving/deletion), creation of layouts/views/fields/choices/highlighting, creation and execution of STRs, creation and management of batch sets, reporting
  • Provide matter specific support on items such as privilege log generation, media tracking, and project specific reporting
  • Understand project budgets and obtain required approvals before incurring additional costs outside of project estimates
  • Ensures continuity of client service between shifts by providing clear handoffs and client updates.
  • Drives overall client satisfaction through effective coordination and communication of client deliverables.
  • Participate in process improvement initiatives and collaborate with teammates to standardize and improve the customer experience
  • Ensure effective control of all aspects of a project from initial planning through final production; development of project plans; balance overall client requirements; development of relationships; and review financial and billing information in a timely manner to ensure deadlines are consistently met.

Qualifications & Characteristics

  • Minimum two-year consulting, litigation support, paralegal or attorney experience in a law firm, corporate legal departments or eDiscovery service provider with an overall experience of four to five years.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Hands-on experience with working on Relativity
  • Proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel and BI is highly desirable and an added advantage.
  • Demonstrated success in working on multiple simultaneous projects.
  • Oral and written communication skills that demonstrate a “white glove” approach to service.
  • Client relationship skills which include the ability to proactively manage client expectations, recognize client needs, and adapt to consistently meet client requirements.
  • Capacity to learn quickly and adapt to changing industry trends.
  • Flexibility to work both night shift timings and occasionally on weekends is required.

The successful individual must be authorised to work in the United Kingdom for any employer and must be a current resident in the United Kingdom.

Your specific salary will be determined based on several factors:

  • Location-based market rate for the role

  • Your abilities in relation to the job specification

  • Performance during screening and interview

  • Pay parity with the wider team in the considered location

Further details about the package will be provided during the initial screening call with the Talent Acquisition Team.

raw.description:
Overview

Build the Future
At McGraw Hill, we deliver digital learning solutions that empower educators and learners worldwide. Our mission is to transform education through intuitive, engaging platforms. Join a collaborative environment where your career can grow as we build solutions that make a meaningful impact

Your role:

As a Senior Backend Software Engineer on the Sharpen team, you will build and evolve the services powering McGraw Hill’s AI-driven learning experiences and digital courseware. You will work across TypeScript and Go microservices, GraphQL and REST APIs, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, AWS, data platforms, and Kubernetes-based infrastructure. This role is for an experienced backend engineer who can lead complex initiatives, influence architecture, and deliver reliable solutions across team boundaries. You will also work within a cross team delivery model to integrate shared services and enable consistent platform capabilities across products.

What You'll Do:

  • Design, develop, test, and operate scalable backend services using both TypeScript and Go.
  • Own services through their full lifecycle, including architecture, delivery, production readiness, operational health, incident response, and continuous improvement.
  • Build and evolve GraphQL and REST APIs, schemas, resolvers, and service contracts with attention to backward compatibility, versioning, schema management, and safe migrations.
  • Design and develop distributed systems and independently deployable microservices.
  • Build event producers and consumers using queues, topics, workers, and asynchronous processing.
  • Develop, deploy, and operate services on Kubernetes and Amazon EKS.
  • Work with AWS services such as DynamoDB, Aurora/RDS, S3, SQS, SNS, Secrets Manager, and ECR.
  • Design data models, schemas, indexes, migrations, and persistence strategies across relational, NoSQL, and graph databases.
  • Partner with multiple engineering teams to plan and deliver shared-service integrations, align technical contracts, and coordinate dependencies.
  • Contribute to a cross-team delivery model by communicating implementation details, managing integration risks, and supporting end-to-end delivery.
  • Improve reliability through automated testing, observability, tracing, logging, alerting, and performance tuning. Use observability platforms such as New Relic to monitor system health, troubleshoot production issues, and improve service performance.
  • Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, technical planning, and production support.
  • Mentor engineers and follow security, compliance, auditability, and change-management practices.

What we Value / What You’ll Need:

  • Passion for using technology to improve educational outcomes.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 8+ years of professional software development experience, including significant experience building and operating production backend services.
  • Strong professional experience developing backend services in both TypeScript and Go.
  • Strong experience with microservices, distributed systems, and service-oriented architectures.
  • Experience designing GraphQL and REST APIs.
  • Experience building and operating event producers and consumers, including queues, topics, retries, and failure handling.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS and Kubernetes, preferably Amazon EKS.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling and databases such as MySQL/Aurora, DynamoDB, Redis, or graph databases. Experience delivering shared-service integrations across multiple teams or products.
  • Experience with observability, monitoring, distributed tracing, centralized logging, and platforms such as New Relic. Demonstrated ability to lead complex initiatives, influence architecture, manage dependencies, and mentor engineers. Experience with CI/CD, production operations, automated testing, and performance optimization.
  • Experience in a SOX- and/or SOC 2-compliant environment is preferred.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience in EdTech or digital learning platforms.
  • Experience with GraphQL federation, gqlgen, Apollo Server, Prisma, sqlc, Gremlin, or Amazon Neptune.
  • AWS Certification
  • Experience building AI/ML-enabled backend services.
  • Familiarity with Terraform, Helm, GitHub Actions, and infrastructure automation.
  • Experience with OpenTelemetry, Sentry, Datadog, or similar observability tools.
  • Experience designing high-volume learning, engagement, analytics, or event-processing systems.

Why work for us?

The work you do at McGraw Hill will be work that matters. We are collectively building experiences that will help shape the future of education. Play your part and experience a sense of fulfilment that will inspire you to even greater heights.

The pay range for this position is between $110,000 - $160,000 annually, however, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location. An annual bonus plan may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical and/or other benefits, depending on the position offered. Sobre Hubtype

Hubtype ayuda a grandes y medianas organizaciones a automatizar y mejorar la experiencia de cliente a través de canales conversacionales: WhatsApp, webchat y chat in-app. Somos proveedor oficial de Meta WhatsApp Business Solution, el primero en conseguir esta certificación en España, y nuestros clientes incluyen aerolíneas, bancos, aseguradoras y retailers en Europa y LATAM.

El rol

Este es un rol 100% outbound para el mercado español. Trabajarás cuentas medianas y grandes de distintos sectores, abriendo conversaciones con directores de experiencia de cliente, operaciones y canales digitales. Son empresas que gestionan un gran volumen de conversaciones con sus clientes y buscan atenderlas mejor, más rápido y con menos coste.

El resto de Hubtype trabaja mayoritariamente con leads inbound. Este rol es la excepción. Buscamos a alguien que disfrute generando oportunidades desde cero, combinando llamada, email y LinkedIn. Tendrás autonomía para organizar tu prospección y trabajarás muy de cerca con el equipo comercial de España.

Valoramos a quien aprende rápido, aplica lo que aprende y lo convierte en resultados. Trabajamos con objetivos claros de actividad, reuniones agendadas y oportunidades generadas, y te acompañaremos con formación sobre el producto y el mercado desde el primer día.

Qué harás

  • Investigar y mapear cuentas objetivo: identificar a quién decide y a quién influye en cada empresa. Trabajarás sectores como retail, banca, seguros, aerolíneas o energía.
  • Construir y ejecutar secuencias multicanal (llamada, email, LinkedIn) hasta conseguir respuesta. Tú decides el ritmo y el mensaje de cada contacto, y los ajustas según los resultados.
  • Hacer llamadas en frío a diario como parte central de tu prospección. Es la actividad principal del rol, y buscamos a alguien que la disfrute.
  • Cualificar oportunidades y agendar reuniones con el equipo de Account Executives en España. Tu objetivo es que cada reunión que entregues tenga una necesidad real y una persona con capacidad de decisión.
  • Usar herramientas de IA para investigar cuentas y personalizar tus mensajes.
  • Mantener el CRM (Salesforce) actualizado: estado de cada cuenta, próximos pasos y motivo de descarte si aplica.
  • Contribuir puntualmente a contenido en LinkedIn que apoye la prospección.

Requirements

Lo que buscamos

Experiencia

  • Al menos un año de experiencia en prospección outbound B2B, combinando llamada, email y LinkedIn.
  • Experiencia contactando con perfiles de decisión (directores, gerentes o C-level).
  • No necesitas venir de SaaS, pero sí haber prospectado activamente y conocer tus números.

Competencias

  • Curiosidad comercial. Capaz de aprender rápido nuestro producto y el negocio de cada cliente, y adaptar el discurso según el sector y la persona con la que hables.
  • Soltura con herramientas de IA para investigar, preparar llamadas y personalizar mensajes.
  • Resiliencia. Vas a escuchar 'no' muchas más veces que 'sí', y necesitas seguir marcando el siguiente número igual de bien.
  • Hambre y ambición. Te exiges resultados, quieres crecer y buscas aprender algo nuevo cada semana.
  • Organización y disciplina para trabajar en remoto, con objetivos claros de llamadas, reuniones agendadas y cuota.

Plus valorados

  • Catalán o francés a nivel C1/C2, no nivel básico ni conversacional.
  • Inglés a nivel profesional.
  • Experiencia en ventas SaaS B2B, muy bien valorada.
  • Experiencia con herramientas de prospección como Apollo, Lemlist o LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
  • Conocimiento de metodologías de cualificación como SPIN, BANT o MEDDIC.

Los CVs con resultados y KPIs demostrables (llamadas realizadas, ratio de conversión, reuniones agendadas, cuota cumplida) tendrán prioridad en el proceso de selección.

Benefits

  • Contrato fijo con periodo de prueba de 6 meses en un puesto en el que tendrás mucho espacio para brillar.
  • Trabajar con personas increíbles de todo el mundo, con diferentes culturas, experiencias y conocimientos.
  • 27 días de vacaciones al año, más el día de tu cumpleaños, más un día de voluntariado, además de los festivos nacionales/locales.
  • Política 100 % remota y horario flexible: confiamos en ti para sacar el trabajo adelante.
  • Plan de beneficios e incentivos, centrado en el aprendizaje y el desarrollo.
  • Presupuesto para equipar tu espacio de trabajo y lograr resultados desde casa.

Protección de datos
Al enviar tu candidatura, das tu consentimiento para que Hubtype conserve tus datos durante un máximo de 12 meses con el fin de contactarte para futuras oportunidades. Puedes pedirnos que eliminemos tus datos en cualquier momento escribiendo a

raw.excerpt: About Decentralized Masters Decentralized Masters is an investment education and research company.
raw.description:
About Decentralized Masters

Decentralized Masters is an investment education and research company. We went from two co-founders to 160+ people and 4,500+ paying members in four years, bootstrapped and profitable. Our business is built on continuity: high-ticket and low-ticket programmes that are membership-based, with payment plans, renewals, upsells and a paid newsletter. We have never taken outside capital. Our growth is still heavily direct-response: paid media on Facebook, YouTube and Google feeds the webinars, calls and offers that fund everything we do.

Our vision is to become the gold standard in investment education and research.

The Role

The Win-Back Specialist brings former members back through relationships, not pressure. This is a new role, the first of its kind at DM. You own the entire win-back pipeline and build the function from the ground up.

The opportunity

  • $500K+ in win-backs closed in the last 3 months, with no one dedicated to it.
  • 2,500+ former members already in the pipeline. They have bought before, so there is no cold prospecting.
  • One owner. You get the whole win-back pipeline, with setter support.

The demand is proven. The role has never existed, so the right person builds it.

What you'll do

  • Own the pipeline. You run the full win-back pipeline, from first touch to close.
  • Build relationships. You nurture former members over the long term and follow up tightly until the timing fits.
  • Solve why they left. You find out what went wrong and fix it, using extra discounts and services where needed to restart them.
  • Close deals. You work mostly self-booked calls with setter support, and pick up overflow renewals when needed.

Target: $150K+ in cash collected per month from month 3, on high-ticket memberships (about $10K+ deals).

Webinars: a win-back webinar runs every 2 months to help close the people you have been talking to.

Requirements

What You Bring

    • A high-ticket track record. You have closed $10K+ deals.
    • Patience with long cycles. You keep relationships warm for months.
    • CRM discipline. You keep clear notes and next steps, and you follow up on time.
    • A consultative approach. You diagnose the problem first, then solve it.
    • Self-starter drive. You book your own meetings and thrive working remotely.
  • This is not a fit if you rely on a high-pressure, one-call-close style, need meetings handed to you or instant wins, are loose with notes and next steps, pitch before understanding the problem, or come from a front-end or appointment-setter background only.
  • Nice to have: renewals, account management or retention experience. No digital assets experience needed.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive commission structure with bonuses.
  • Full-time, 40 hours a week, with a flexible schedule and unlimited PTO.
  • Entirely remote, working from anywhere in the world, with team off-sites.
  • A supportive, dynamic culture with team members across 30+ countries.

How we hire

  1. Recruiter screen: must-haves, comfort with commission-only pay, long-cycle mindset.
  2. Interview with Renewals Manager: track record and how you nurture a book.
  3. Role play: a mock win-back call with an unhappy ex-member.
  4. Decision: offer and start date.

Join Sparklight's fastest growing team as a Business Care Specialist! As a Business Care Specialist, you will be the go-to contact for our business enterprise level customers. You will be answering questions regarding invoices, installations, and updating changes in our customers' accounts via phone, email and chat.

We are open to hiring remote if we find the right talent in any of these states:AL, AK, AR, AZ, FL, GA, IA, ID, IL, IN, KS, LA, MN, MO, MS, NC, ND, NE, NM, OR, OK, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT. 

What you will do to contribute to the company's success 

  • Answering calls from Sparklight business customers and responding to inquiries in a professional manner. 

  • Providing accurate, prompt, and consistent support to business customer needs by following Standard Operating Procedures (SOP).

  • Responding to and resolving business customer situations, including billing discrepancies, in a courteous, professional manner.

  • Providing post-installation care, including entering changes of service into the Single View software platform.

  • Responding to web chat inquiries from business customers on the Business Services Website in a courteous and professional manner.

  • Navigating and notating back office processing tools for selected calls.

  • Providing timely feedback to Sparklight leadership regarding service issues or customer concerns. 

  • Other duties and/or responsibilities not specifically set forth above may, however, be assigned as needed. 

Qualifications 

  • High school diploma or general education degree (GED); and one to two years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience. 

  • We care a lot about our customers! We are looking for someone who is customer service-oriented with experience with providing customer service over the phone. Data entry experience is important to us too. 

  • Experience in Microsoft Outlook, Word, and Excel. 

  • Knowledgeable in Salesforce.com and Single View is preferred.

Core Competencies  

  • Committed: Values each and every customer, while working hard to keep their business and support our communities.  

  • Helpful: Delivers support in the ways that are most useful to our customers and addresses their needs with expertise, respect, and empathy.  

  • Proactive: Understand what our customers need, and actively works to make their relationship with use seamless, easy, and rewarding.  

  • Personal: Knows our customers well, and tailors our communications and interactions to address their needs and expectations.  

Benefits 

Cable One and our family of brands appreciates the role our associates play to help the company grow, and in return an excellent benefits package is offered to our associates to recognize the importance of their contributions, such as:  

  • Medical, dental, and vision plans – start when you start!  

  • Life insurance (self, spouse, children) 

  • Paid time off (vacation, holiday, and personal/sick days)  

  • 401(k) - 100% company match (match program starts after 1 year of service, up to 5% of eligible compensation) 

  • Group Legal plan with Identity Theft Protection 

Additional Perks  

  • Tuition reimbursement (up to $5,250 on 1st year)  

  • Up to seventy-five dollars a month towards cable and internet services  

  • Annual community support to various organizations across the U.S.  

  • Associate recognition & awards programs 

  • Advancement opportunities  

  • Collaborative work environment  

We’re an Award-Winning Organization! 

  • 2022 - 2023 Forbes’ “America’s Best Midsized Employers” 

Our Commitment 

Diversity lies in the communities we serve and among the associates who dedicate themselves to ensure our continued success. Here at Cable One and our family of brands, we believe it is our individual and unique talents, backgrounds and perspectives that, when combined, truly make us an unstoppable force. "Stronger Together" is not just a verbal cue, it is the motto that our associates live by, exemplify, and embody each and every day.  

Cable One and our family of brands is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, among other things, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, status as a protected veteran, or disability. 

 

Pre-hire Processes 

Cable One and our family of brands is committed to keeping our associates and customers safe. Job offers are contingent upon the results of background, drug screening, and reference check. Only after successfully passing these pre-hire clearances are individuals approved for hire and ready to start their successful and rewarding career.

raw.description:
Job Description

Social Creative & Production Manager

As the Social Creative Manager at Zendesk, you'll help define what great social-first creative looks like for a global technology brand.

We're looking for a creative thinker and hands-on maker who knows how to turn big ideas, complex technology, and timely conversations into content people actually want to engage with. From scroll-stopping videos and bold visual concepts to clever social campaigns and executive content, you'll bring fresh creative thinking to how Zendesk shows up across LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and emerging platforms.


You will turn company priorities, customer stories, product news, thought leadership content, and industry conversations into sharp, platform-native content that earns attention and builds credibility with AI decision-makers and other audiences. You will work closely with brand, product marketing, sales, and PR teams to ensure a consistent, compelling, and integrated brand voice across all social touchpoints, driving measurable impact on our B2B growth objectives. You are a creative, resourceful maker with strong editorial judgment, hands-on production skills, and the instincts to recognize when a moment is worth responding to.


AI fluency is important, too. We're looking for someone who is excited to experiment with emerging creative tools to make production smarter and unlock new possibilities, without sacrificing originality, authenticity, or editorial judgment.


About the Team

This role is part of Zendesk’s brand and content organization and works in close partnership with brand, editorial, product marketing, customer marketing,field marketing, PR and executive communications. The team combines creativity, audience insight, and cross-functional collaboration to strengthen Zendesk’s public presence and support business priorities. This role focuses on producing social content for both Zendesk and its executives.


Here’s What You’ll Do Day-to-day

Concepting & Production

  • Lead ideation and hands-on production of original, social-first content across Zendesk's owned channels, primarily LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.
  • Develop compelling concepts for product launches, brand campaigns, customer stories, industry conversations, and other priority moments.
  • Design and produce social-first graphics, carousels, animations, short-form videos, and other visual content from concept through final delivery.
  • Write and collaborate on engaging social copy, hooks, scripts, captions, and creative treatments that complement visual storytelling.
  • Transform complex topics like AI, automation, and service into accessible, engaging, and visually compelling content.
  • Adapt larger brand campaigns into creative that feels native to each social platform rather than simply resizing existing assets.
  • Partner with internal designers, video producers, and external creative resources on more complex production needs.

Social-First Storytelling & Innovation

  • Bring a strong understanding of social culture, platform trends, emerging formats, and audience behavior to the creative process.
  • Proactively pitch fresh, unexpected ideas that help Zendesk stand out from traditional B2B technology brands.
  • Identify opportunities for timely, relevant, and culturally aware creative that connects Zendesk to broader industry conversations.
  • Experiment with new formats, visual approaches, and storytelling techniques to continuously evolve our social presence.
  • Explore and apply AI-powered creative tools across design, video, ideation, and production while maintaining strong creative judgment and quality standards.

Executive & Thought Leadership Social Content

  • Develop creative concepts and assets supporting Zendesk's executive social presence.
  • Translate executive perspectives, industry insights, and thought leadership into compelling visual and multimedia content.
  • Support executive video content, including creative concepts, scripts, editing, and repurposing longer-form conversations into engaging social clips.

Creative Collaboration & Execution

  • Collaborate with the Senior Social Media & Influencer Manager to translate social strategy and business priorities into creative concepts and deliverables.
  • Partner with Brand, Product Marketing, PR, Communications, and other stakeholders to develop and execute social creative for launches, campaigns, and events.
  • Own assigned creative projects from brief through production, feedback, approvals, and final delivery.
  • Manage creative timelines and deliverables, balancing planned initiatives with timely content opportunities.
  • Work with the broader social team to ensure creative aligns with publishing schedules, platform best practices, and audience needs.
  • Use social performance insights, creative testing, and audience feedback to continually refine and improve content.

Here’s What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years of overall marketing, communications, journalism, or content experience, with at least 5 years focused on social media or digital content.
  • Proven experience building social content for a B2B, technology, AI,SaaS, or similarly complex brand.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent social writing and hands-on creation of graphics, carousels, and short-form video.
  • Strong command of design and video editing tools, such as Canva, Adobe Creative Cloud, or equivalent.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling skills, including the ability to adapt voice and format for different executives, audiences, and platforms.
  • Experience developing executive social content or thought leadership, with the judgment to make it sound credible and personal.
  • A sharp eye for competitive activity and emerging conversations, and the ability to turn relevant moments into timely content.
  • Strong creative judgment and a practical, resourceful approach to producing high-quality work on tight timelines.
  • Comfort working with senior leaders and cross-functional partners in a fast-moving, matrixed organization.
  • Ability to use social analytics and audience feedback to make content more effective.
  • AI fluency, including thoughtful use of AI tools across ideation and production, with careful review for accuracy, voice, and quality.
  • BA/BS degree required.

What Success Looks Like

  • Zendesk's social channels feature more original, distinctive, and platform-native creative.
  • Product launches and priority campaigns are supported by compelling social-first concepts rather than repurposed marketing assets.
  • The social team can move more quickly from creative idea to finished content without sacrificing quality.
  • Executive social content benefits from stronger visual storytelling and engaging multimedia formats.
  • New creative formats and approaches are regularly tested, with learnings informing future content.
  • Social creative consistently balances originality, audience relevance, and measurable performance.

The intelligent heart of customer experience

Zendesk software was built to bring a sense of calm to the chaotic world of customer service. Today we power billions of conversations with brands you know and love.

Zendesk believes in offering our people a fulfilling and inclusive experience. Our hybrid way of working, enables us to purposefully come together in person, at one of our many Zendesk offices around the world, to connect, collaborate and learn whilst also giving our people the flexibility to work remotely for part of the week.

As part of our commitment to fairness and transparency, we inform all applicants that artificial intelligence (AI) or automated decision systems may be used to screen or evaluate applications for this position, in accordance with Company guidelines and applicable law.

Zendesk is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts to foster global diversity, equity, & inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment and employees at Zendesk are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are an AA/EEO/Veterans/Disabled employer. If you are based in the United States and would like more information about your EEO rights under the law, please click here.

Zendesk endeavors to make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities and disabled veterans pursuant to applicable federal and state law. If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to submit this application, complete any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participate in the employee selection process, please send an e-mail to with your specific accommodation request.

raw.description:
Salvo Software is a global technology company specializing in custom software development and advanced engineering solutions. With distributed teams across the US, LATAM, and India, we partner with clients to build high-performance, scalable systems that solve complex technical challenges. Our culture values innovation, ownership, and engineering excellence.

Role Overview
We are seeking a DevOps Engineer to serve as the sole technical owner of our cloud environments, delivery pipelines, and AI infrastructure. In this “department of one” role, you will be the foundational expert ensuring that our hand-selected teams have the secure, high-performance infrastructure they need to deliver excellence to our partners.

This position is fully DevOps-focused, owning CI/CD, automation, cloud infrastructure, security, and AI systems end to end.

Key Responsibilities

  • Cloud Architecture: Design, manage, and optimize cloud infrastructure on AWS, GCP, or Azure to support both internal needs and client-facing digital transformations.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Define and manage infrastructure through code (Terraform or similar) to keep environments consistent, reproducible, and auditable.
  • CI/CD Pipelines: Build, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, etc.) to ensure rapid, high-quality software delivery.
  • Containerization: Oversee Docker and Kubernetes environments to ensure scalable and reliable application hosting.
  • Observability: Manage monitoring, logging, and alerting systems to proactively address performance and availability issues.
  • Cloud Security & Access: Define and enforce identity, access management, and least-privilege controls, including strict access levels for sensitive, licensed OEM data to ensure project-based compliance.
  • Cost Optimization: Monitor cloud spend and right-size resources to keep infrastructure efficient as the company scales.
  • AI Systems: Set up, integrate, and maintain AI/ML systems and tooling to support the company’s growing use of intelligent automation.
  • Programming & Scripting: Develop and maintain automation scripts and internal tooling using Python, Bash, or similar languages.
  • Infrastructure Strategy: Guide the company’s infrastructure roadmap, evaluating tools and practices and recommending what’s worth adopting.

Requirements

  • Experience: 7+ years in a DevOps or Cloud Engineering role. Proven ability to operate independently in a solo contributor capacity.
  • Cloud: Hands-on, deep experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure (architecture, cost optimization, security).
  • Infrastructure as Code: Hands-on experience with Terraform or similar tools.
  • Containers: Strong experience with Docker and Kubernetes in production.
  • CI/CD: Hands-on experience designing, maintaining, and troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar platforms).
  • Programming: Strong scripting and automation skills in Python, Bash, or similar.
  • Security: Solid understanding of cloud security, IAM, secrets management, and DevSecOps practices.
  • AI Experience (Preferred): Hands-on experience deploying or managing AI/ML systems or LLM-based tooling.
  • Mindset: A “smart decision-maker” who can guide the company’s infrastructure strategy while remaining deeply hands-on with daily tasks.
  • Location/Communication: Comfortable supporting a global team across different time zones (US, Mexico, India).

By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.

Newsweek Recognizes Sedgwick as America’s Greatest Workplaces National Top Companies

Certified as a Great Place to Work®

Fortune Best Workplaces in Financial Services & Insurance

Data Engineering Manager

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS and RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Leads the data engineering function responsible for scalable batch, real-time streaming, and event-driven data movement across on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Owns or significantly contributes to the design and architecture of Property Insurance data solutions, from source-system integration through operational, analytical, reporting, regulatory, data science, and AI consumption.
  • Owns the data engineering roadmap and converts business, analytics, architecture, and platform priorities into sequenced team deliverables.
  • Provides people leadership, including work assignment, coaching, performance feedback, career development, workforce planning, and capability building for data engineering colleagues.
  • Establishes and governs engineering standards for Snowflake, data modeling, storage structures, secure data sharing, transformation pipelines, testing, observability, documentation, and platform performance.
  • Translates Property Insurance requirements covering policies, coverage, insureds, risks, properties, claims, losses, reserves, payments, recoveries, deductibles, limits, exposure, underwriting, brokers, carriers, and reinsurance into sustainable logical and physical data architectures.
  • Applies practical knowledge of the Lloyd's of London market, including market structures, participants, placement, underwriting, claims, brokers, carriers, and syndicates, to enterprise data models, integration patterns, and reporting structures.
  • Leads modernization of legacy SQL Server databases, stored procedures, SSIS packages, SSRS reports, and .NET applications toward Snowflake and modern cloud-based data architectures while maintaining operational stability and business continuity.
  • Oversees the design and delivery of high-quality data inputs to Snowflake, dbt AI features, semantic layers, and metadata models that support Self-Service 2.0 and natural-language user interfaces.
  • Defines reference architectures, reusable templates, CI/CD controls, and review practices that enable decentralized line-of-business teams to build data products safely and consistently.
  • Conducts architecture, technical design, data model, and code reviews to ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, secure, cost-effective, and aligned with enterprise standards.
  • Guides adoption of dbt and evaluates the appropriate use of AWS and Azure data services, including Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions, and Stream Analytics.
  • Partners with enterprise architecture, product, analytics, application development, AI, security, governance, infrastructure, and Property Insurance business stakeholders to deliver end-to-end solutions, resolve dependencies, and manage delivery risks.
  • Incorporates data quality, lineage, metadata, security, privacy, governance, validation, reconciliation, exception handling, and monitoring requirements into solution designs and critical data pipelines.
  • Establishes service health, data quality, delivery, and operational metrics; uses results to prioritize reliability, performance, and continuous improvement.
  • Manages vendor or consulting relationships supporting data engineering, when applicable, and contributes to capacity, technology investment, and budget planning.
  • Remains sufficiently hands-on to review architecture and code, guide complex technical decisions, and support resolution of high-impact production issues.

ADDITIONAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Supports the organization’s quality program(s).
  • Travel as required.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Directly manages data engineering colleagues and is accountable for team performance, development, work allocation, and succession planning.
  • Builds team capability through coaching, technical mentorship, knowledge sharing, and disciplined engineering practices.
  • Provides matrix leadership and technical direction to decentralized analysts and cross-functional contributors building data products.

QUALIFICATIONS


Education & Licensing
Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, data engineering, or a related field from an accredited college or university preferred.

Equivalent combination of education, professional certifications, and relevant work experience will be considered.


Experience

  • Seven (7)+ years of progressive data engineering experience, including delivery of production-grade data pipelines and cloud data solutions, required.
  • Two (2)+ years of formal people leadership, team lead, or comparable responsibility for directing engineering work and developing technical talent, preferred.
  • Advanced experience with Snowflake architecture, performance tuning, data modeling, storage structures, and secure data sharing required.
  • Significant hands-on development and engineering experience with Microsoft SQL Server, T-SQL/SQL, SSIS, SSRS, and .NET/C# required.
  • Demonstrated experience modernizing legacy Microsoft-based data platforms and applications toward Snowflake or comparable modern cloud architectures required.
  • Experience leading delivery across hybrid environments using batch, streaming, and event-driven patterns required.
  • Experience establishing engineering standards, CI/CD practices, data quality controls, and operational support models required.
  • Deep experience with Property Insurance data and business processes across policies, claims, coverage, losses, financial transactions, and related insurance entities required.
  • Lloyd's of London market experience, including its terminology, structures, participants, placement, underwriting, claims, and associated insurance data, required.
  • Experience with semantic layers and structuring data for downstream AI, large language model, or natural-language search capabilities preferred.
  • Experience partnering across architecture, security, governance, analytics, AI, and business teams preferred.

Skills & Knowledge

  • Advanced knowledge of Snowflake architecture, performance tuning, data modeling, storage structures, and secure data sharing.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server, T-SQL/SQL, SSIS, SSRS, and .NET/C#, including relational and dimensional modeling, query optimization, and database performance.
  • Strong knowledge of scalable batch, real-time streaming, and event-driven data pipeline architecture.
  • Strong working knowledge of dbt, semantic layers, metadata models, Python, SQL, CI/CD, testing, observability, and cloud data services.
  • Knowledge of Azure data tools, including Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions, and Stream Analytics; familiarity with AWS data ecosystems.
  • Deep knowledge of Property Insurance concepts, processes, terminology, and data, with the ability to translate business requirements into enterprise data architectures and engineerbing solutions.
  • Practical knowledge of the Lloyd's of London insurance market and the ability to translate Lloyd's-specific concepts into data models, integrations, and reporting structures.
  • Knowledge of data quality, lineage, metadata management, governance, privacy, role-based access control, reconciliation, exception handling, and data observability practices.
  • People leadership skills, including coaching, delegation, performance feedback, talent development, and team capacity planning.
  • Ability to translate strategy into a practical roadmap, prioritize competing demands, manage dependencies, and communicate delivery risks.
  • Ability to establish governance without limiting responsible self-service delivery across decentralized teams.
  • Strong stakeholder, vendor, analytical, problem-solving, organizational, presentation, and written communication skills.

raw.description:
About us

Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and .

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

The opportunity

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Payments engineering team within the E-commerce department. Payments takes, refunds and reconciles customer money across our white-label booking sites, subscriptions and in-person sales points, integrating with providers such as Adyen, PayPal and Checkout.com. Correctness, reliability and security are non-negotiable.

You might lead more than one team from the start, and as the department grows, the scope of this role can expand to other engineering areas. We need someone with real payments depth who also wants to grow as a multi-team leader. We invest in AI-assisted development, from shared agent skills to AI-driven SDLC tooling, and we expect our leaders to shape how their teams work with it.

What you will do:

  • Lead several engineering teams, working through tech leads to set direction, priorities and delivery across them.

  • Hire, coach and grow senior engineers and future leaders. Own performance, career development and team structure as the area scales.

  • Own the health of our payment platform: reliability, idempotency, provider failover, webhook handling and incident response.

  • Shape the roadmap with Product, balancing new payment methods and markets against platform investment, cost and provider fees.

  • Partner with White Label, Orders, Finance and Data teams on checkout, refunds, chargebacks, reconciliation and the payment ledger.

  • Stay close to system design and architecture of our event-driven services (Ruby, Kafka), and set the technical bar across your teams.

  • Raise the bar on ownership: documentation, runbooks, observability and on-call.

  • Champion AI-assisted engineering across your teams: coding agents, AI code review, test generation and documentation. Measure which practices improve delivery and quality.

  • Define safe guardrails for AI use where money moves: human review, test coverage and auditability stay non-negotiable.

Workplace:

We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe and a HQ in Berlin.

Requirements

Who you are:

  • An experienced Engineering Manager who has led multiple teams or a team of senior engineers.

  • Required: hands-on background in payments. You've built or run payment systems in production, including PSP integrations, refunds and chargebacks, reconciliation and recurring billing.

  • You understand PCI DSS, SCA/3DS and what it takes to keep money flows auditable.

  • An engineer at heart, with experience in event-driven distributed systems (Kafka or similar) and strong skills in a modern backend language. Ruby is a plus.

  • You're comfortable working across teams and departments, and you communicate clearly in writing in English.

  • You use AI tools in your own day-to-day work, not just in theory. You've helped a team adopt them, and you can tell real productivity gains from hype.

    Nice to have: card-present/terminal payments, SEPA direct debit, multi-currency, travel or marketplace experience.


What you can expect:

  • Make a global impact. Help shape how millions of people discover and book ground transportation worldwide.

  • Own your work. Take responsibility from day one and see the direct impact of your contributions.

  • Build with the best tools. We move fast, continuously evolve our tech stack, and invest in modern, efficient solutions.

  • Work with industry leaders. Our partners include , Google Maps, Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.

  • Grow with exceptional people. Join an international team that will challenge, support, and inspire you every day.

  • Work your way. Enjoy flexible and remote-friendly working options, relocation opportunities, and plenty of room to grow.

Our hiring team for this role:
Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is Masha Marynova, and the Hiring Manager (HM) is Roger Singrau.
For any queries, contact your Talent Partner at ().

Do you want to work on a product that is used by millions of people daily, with high load, availability and scalability, and the most advanced technology? Come join us!

Highlights

We deliver projects and features that our Product and Business teams expect to scale business activity with our Carriers and Retailers.

title: People Operations Coordinator
description: Who We are: At Wagepoint, we’re good people.  Sure, maybe we’re biased.

raw.title: People Operations Coordinator
raw.excerpt: Who We are: At Wagepoint, we’re good people.  Sure, maybe we’re biased.
raw.description:
Who We are:

At Wagepoint, we’re good people. Sure, maybe we’re biased. But that’s only because Wagepointers bring the best versions of ourselves to do some of the best work in our careers.

We’re an authentic team who bring our diverse backgrounds, ideas, experiences and cultures together to make payroll magic. Speaking of, we “pull rabbits out of hats” for thousands of small business owners across Canada who rely on our payroll software to pay their employees and process their payroll taxes. And we’re just getting started.

We’re growing and looking for more awesome people to join our merry band of misfits. We are looking for people who share our understanding that when it comes to our commitment to our customers: we mean business. Especially given that the consequences of getting payroll wrong can sometimes be dire.

If you are the kind of person who has always wanted to make a difference and be heard at work, Wagepoint will give you plenty of opportunity to do just that.

The Role at High Level:

We’re looking for a talented People Operations Coordinator who enjoys tackling hard problems and wants to create meaningful impact for small businesses across Canada. You'll keep People Operations running day to day, own onboarding from pre-boarding through a new hire's first 90 days, turn our people data into useful insight, and lead the automation of our People Ops workflows and reporting. You will report directly to our People Operations Manager & People Business Partner.

What You'll Be Expected To Own:

  • Create a great first impression for every new hire, from welcome emails and Day 1 schedules to equipment and system access with IT, our Wagemate program pairings, and 30/60/90-day check-ins.

  • Deliver Wagepoint's orientation program, gather new hire feedback, and keep orientation materials fresh.

  • Be the go-to resource for employee questions, translating policy and benefits details into plain language and managing benefits resources, FAQs, and updates.

  • Support performance review and compensation cycles with logistics, communications, reminders, and data cleanup, and keep People Ops policies and documentation current.

  • Process HRIS changes accurately and on time, complete our HR compliance calendar tasks, and maintain SOPs, templates, and regular documentation audits.

  • Maintain the dataset behind our workforce planning, build ARR per FTE and talent density reporting, and keep our people dashboards (headcount, hiring, turnover, engagement) accurate and current.

  • Administer our learning management system (LMS), track mandatory training completion, follow up on outstanding training, and coordinate new learning rollouts and the company training calendar.

  • Maintain our tools, knowledge base and systems, including employee data and documentation, with accuracy and confidentiality.

  • Own the automation of People Ops workflows and reporting with IT, starting with the tasks that repeat most and take the most time, and track the hours you save.

  • Compile, analyze, and spot patterns in the data and bring them to People Ops leadership so plans rest on facts.

  • Help managers show up for their teams during key People moments with timely and effective guides, reminders, and resources.

  • Pitch in on engagement programs, recognition initiatives, all-hands, and team events, and support recruiting coordination during peak hiring.

What You Bring To The Table:

  • 1–2 years of experience in HR, People Operations, HR analytics, or a related administrative role.

  • Experience with an HRIS and/or an Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

  • Comfort working across Google Workspace, Slack, and learning management systems.

  • Strong spreadsheet skills (e.g., Google Sheets) and comfort building simple reports and dashboards.

  • A data-minded approach: you're accurate, curious about patterns, and able to explain numbers in plain language.

  • Experience with, or keen interest in, workflow automation and AI tools, such as HRIS workflows, no-code automation, and AI assistants.

  • Strong organization and attention to detail, so nothing falls through the cracks.

  • Discretion with sensitive people information and a privacy-minded approach, including working with anonymized data.

  • Warm, clear communication that gives new hires and employees a great experience.

  • You're adaptable, proactive, and self-directed, and you take ownership.

Bonus points if:

  • You have post-secondary education in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • You've already built workflow automations or reports that saved your team real time.

  • You're familiar with PIPEDA and Canadian HR compliance requirements.

  • You've used HiBob or a similar HRIS.

  • You're bilingual in English and French.

What We Bring To The Table:

Impact: Roll up your sleeves and directly contribute to the growth and success of Wagepoint by shaping our workforce.

Culture: The opportunity to work with the world’s friendliest team, solving interesting problems together with an endless amount of laughter (We work hard, but we always have time for a bad joke or two).

Growth: Opportunities for professional development and career advancement - we are always, always learning with a growth oriented mindset.

Innovation: Work in an environment that encourages creativity and new ideas.

Remote:The ability to work from home, forever! Wagepoint is a remote company, so you don’t have to worry about commuting to an office. Plus, more time with your pets is always a bonus!

Ready to embark on an exciting journey with us? Apply now and help us build the future of Wagepoint!

Next Steps:

If all the above feels right and proper, please don’t feel like you need to send us an uninspired cover letter. Just send us your updated resume and perhaps a few lines on what excites you about the job - we really want to get to know who you are, not just about how we can work together. If we believe you’re a good match, someone from our team will reach out to schedule a call.

Psssst!

Wagepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and appreciate all applicants with diverse backgrounds, races, religions, genders, identities, ages, experiences (the list goes on!). We are committed to making not only our workplace safe and inclusive for everyone, but also ensuring our recruitment process reflects that. We are a remote company, so there's no need to travel to an office for an interview, but if you require any special accommodation during our recruitment process, please let us know. We are more than happy to assist!

This job posting is for an existing vacancy.

As part of our hiring process, AI-based tools are used to support the initial review of applications. Rest assured, our People Ops team carefully reviews all applications and makes the final decisions on candidate progression.

EverPro - Product Manager, Service Fusion Dispatcher Experience

EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals.


We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here:


EverPro, a business within EverCommerce, provides software and solutions designed to help home and field service businesses run and grow their companies with greater efficiency and confidence. EverPro brings together purpose-built tools across key trades - including field service, remodelling and roofing, landscaping, and pest and lawn - so service professionals can manage operations, engage customers, and drive long-term growth.

Our solutions support the full lifecycle of running a service business, from scheduling and dispatching work, to estimating, invoicing, and payments, to customer communication, reputation management, and business insights. Together, these connected solutions help service pros win more jobs, save time, and build stronger, more resilient businesses.

About the Role

We’re seeking a Product Manager to improve how dispatchers and office teams plan, schedule, and coordinate work through Service Fusion, EverPro’s field service management platform.

Your focus will include dispatching, scheduling, Service Agreements, and recurring service workflows. You’ll help teams turn customer commitments into scheduled work, respond to changing priorities, and keep technicians and customers informed throughout the day.

Working with Product leadership, you’ll own a focused roadmap and lead discovery, prioritization, delivery, and iteration for your product area. You’ll partner closely with Design and Engineering to simplify complex workflows, reduce manual coordination, and help service businesses deliver reliable customer experiences.

Core Responsibilities

  • Own and prioritize a roadmap for dispatching, scheduling, Service Agreements, and related office workflows.
  • Build a deep understanding of how dispatchers manage technician availability, recurring work, urgent requests, and schedule changes.
  • Improve the Service Agreement lifecycle, including agreement setup, recurring visit planning, scheduling, renewals, and coordination with invoicing and payments.
  • Partner with the Mobile product team to keep office and field workflows connected.
  • Lead discovery, usability testing, and early access feedback to validate solutions before broader release.
  • Define requirements, success measures, and launch plans with Engineering, Design, and customer-facing teams.
  • Measure improvements in workflow adoption, time to schedule work, manual effort, and successful completion of recurring service visits.
  • Explore practical AI capabilities, such as scheduling recommendations, identifying unscheduled commitments, and assisting with routine coordination.

Skills and Experience needed for success in this role


  • 5+ years in product management, ideally in B2B SaaS, reporting/analytics platforms, or workflow-heavy business software.
  • Experience owning customer-facing product areas and delivering measurable customer and business outcomes.
  • Strong ability to turn customer discovery, data analytics, and business goals into clear product strategy and roadmap decisions.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS metrics, including adoption, retention, engagement, customer satisfaction, and feature usage.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams across data engineering, software engineering, design, GTM, support, customer success, and leadership.
  • Excellent communicator who can engage both executive stakeholders and hands-on delivery teams.
  • Comfortable using AI tools to improve productivity, accelerate learning, synthesize information, and raise the quality of product work.
  • Curious about how AI can create meaningful value for Dispatchers through automated insights and reputation management.
  • Strong analytical, financial acumen, and prioritization skills.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with field service management, trade contractors, construction, or home/facility service businesses.
  • Experience with SaaS pricing/packaging levers, FinTech, or financial reporting metrics.

Where
The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Jordan, New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role will be remote. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.

Benefits and Perks:

  • Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in-office, remote, or hybrid
  • Continued investment in your professional development
  • Day 1 access to a robust health and wellness benefits, including an annual wellness stipend
  • 401k with up to a 4% match and immediate vesting
  • Flexible and generous (FTO) time-off
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program

Compensation: The target base compensation for this position $110,000 - $160,000 USD per year. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, and candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.


EverCommerce is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We look forward to reviewing your credentials and getting to know more about your experience!


EverCommerce uses approved artificial intelligence (“AI”) tools to support its business operations. Employees are encouraged to use authorized AI tools, when appropriate for their roles, to improve efficiency, quality, and innovation. All AI use must comply with company policies, including requirements concerning confidentiality, data security, intellectual property, accuracy, and human review. Employees remain responsible for reviewing and validating AI-assisted work.

raw.description:
About ALC
A la Carte Solutions (ALC) is an Inc. 5000 firm. We provide outsourced finance, accounting and HR services to about 80 businesses across the US. Our brand promise is Wow Professionally, Care Personally, and it shapes how we treat clients and each other.

The Role
ALC built its own operating platform, ALC PACE. It has already replaced several third-party tools and is on its way to being the one system our team uses to run the firm. We’re looking for a senior, hands-on builder to own it.

You’ll architect, write, review and ship code every day. You’ll use Claude Code and similar AI tools heavily, and you’ll own the quality of what they produce. You’ll also lead the build of ALC’s first products for clients: a client portal, plus AI agents and automations for client workflows.

This isn’t a ticket-taking job. It’s for someone at manager-to-director level who still wants to build. You’ll sit with the people who use the platform, learn how the business works, and build what actually moves it forward. As the platform grows, you’ll set the standards, documentation and release process that let it scale, and eventually let a team build on it.

This is a fully remote role for candidates based in Latin America. You’ll work in your local time zone. You’ll also need the flexibility to join meetings and support colleagues in the US and other time zones when the work calls for it. All work is in English.

Our Stack
ALC PACE · GitHub · Railway · Neon (Postgres) · Claude Code · HubSpot (migrating into PACE) · third-party APIs

What You’ll Do: Wow Professionally

  • Own the architecture: Turn PACE into one connected system. Reporting, time review, billing, CRM, client operations and HR workflows should all share a single Postgres data model.
  • Build and ship every day: Own features end to end, from the first conversation with a stakeholder through build, deployment and support. Ship through a clean, repeatable release process.
  • Replace outside tools with PACE: Lead the move of our HubSpot CRM into PACE, redesigning the process rather than copying the old tool. Recommend which tools to replace next.
  • Turn spreadsheets into apps: Convert Excel models (capacity planning, direct margin, client profitability) into live features.

  • Build AI agents and automations: Design, build and evaluate agents and automations for internal and client workflows, including tool use, retrieval, prompt design and evaluation.
  • Own the quality of AI-written code: Review AI output like a draft from a talented junior engineer. Catch logic errors, security gaps and data-integrity problems before users see them.
  • Document everything: Write architecture, data model and runbook docs so the platform doesn’t depend on any one person’s knowledge.

How You’ll Show Up: Care Personally

  • Partner with stakeholders: Sit with leadership and department heads, ask good questions, and turn how they work into clear requirements. Push back respectfully when a request wouldn’t serve the bigger system.
  • Build with the business in mind: Know whether a feature saves time, improves margin or makes a client’s life easier, and prioritize accordingly.
  • Speak plainly: Explain technical tradeoffs and write updates that non-engineers can follow.
  • Drive adoption, not just delivery: Support the team through changes like the HubSpot migration so new tools actually get used.

What Success Looks Like

  • 30 days: You’re set up locally, you know the architecture and data model, and you’ve shipped your first fixes to production.
  • 90 days: You’ve owned a meaningful feature end to end and written a prioritized plan for risk and technical debt.
  • 180 days: You’re the go-to owner for major parts of the platform. You’ve led a spreadsheet-to-app or HubSpot migration workstream, contributed to the client portal, and set standards others can build on.

Requirements

You Bring

  • A track record of real, shipped work. A degree isn’t required.
  • 7+ years building and shipping web applications, including owning production systems end to end.
  • Experience as a technical lead or architect: setting standards, reviewing code and owning a platform or product area.
  • Fluency in a modern web stack: JavaScript/TypeScript, React or similar, and Node or Python.
  • Strong SQL and data modeling, with Postgres preferred.
  • Hands-on integration work with REST APIs, webhooks and authentication flows.
  • Daily use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar), with examples of catching their mistakes.
  • Solid Git workflow and production deployment experience on a cloud platform.
  • Professional English, strong enough to lead stakeholder meetings and write documentation for non-technical colleagues.
  • Flexibility to work across time zones, including regular overlap with US-based colleagues.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building AI agents or LLM-powered workflows
  • Experience replacing SaaS products with custom software, or building internal tools or ERPs
  • Experience migrating HubSpot or other CRM data
  • Exposure to finance, accounting, HR or professional services operations
  • Experience building multi-tenant client portals
  • Experience with Railway, Neon or similar platforms

How You Think
You’re a systems thinker: before you build, you ask where the data comes from, where it goes and what else it touches. You can take a loosely defined problem, scope it and ship something useful. You move fast with AI tools without trusting them blindly.

Benefits
