raw.description:
​​Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Insurance Admin Assistant

Compensation range: $1,200 AUD - $1,600 AUD / Monthly

Engagement type:Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with the AU business hours (approx. 9 AM - 5 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration, but as a contractor, you’ll have flexibility in how you manage your time.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: We operate within the financial services and personal insurance industry, helping individuals, families, and business owners protect their financial wellbeing against unexpected life events. Our focus is on making insurance more accessible, straightforward, and affordable through tailored coverage options and expert guidance.

We provide general advice on Life, TPD, Trauma and Income Protection cover. Clients come through mortgage brokers and an SMSF accounting partner. We place cover with 11 Australian retail insurers, and our licensee is Sustainable Life Solutions.

Role Overview: We are looking for an experienced life insurance Admin Assistant to work remotely from the Philippines. The role is the founder's right hand and starts in mid-to-late January 2027.

We serve about 620 clients and submit 25 to 35 applications a month. We run 20 to 30 client appointments a week. This role takes over the day-to-day processing, follow-up, and client servicing to help us focus on clients, broker partners, and growing the business

Key Responsibilities:

The priority is clearing outstanding underwriting requirements so applications get to completion. There are about 30 such pending cases today.

1. Suspense and new business management (priority)

  • Track every submitted application through to completion across 12 insurers.
  • Once an application is submitted, order any blood tests or medicals with the paramedical agency as soon as possible.
  • Follow up outstanding underwriting requirements with clients, doctors and insurers. These include medicals, blood tests, GP and specialist reports, financial evidence and signed forms.
  • Work with insurers' Business Development Managers (BDMs) to push stalled cases through, liaising directly with each insurer's new business and underwriting teams as needed.
  • Keep clients updated in plain English so applications don't stall.
  • Prepare and process implementation paperwork once cover is accepted.
  • Once the policy is issued, update the CRM with the policy details. These include the insurer, policy number, cover types and amounts, premium, commencement date, and any loadings or exclusions.
  • For replacement cover, such as moving clients from super-fund cover to a retail policy, make sure the old cover isn't cancelled until the new policy is in force.

2. Follow-up of quoted clients and lead management

  • Follow up clients via email or SMS who have been presented with insurance options but haven't proceeded.
  • Book them back in with John to complete the application, or confirm they don't wish to go ahead.
  • Close leads that won't proceed in the CRM, with the reason recorded.
  • Update the referring mortgage broker or partner on the outcome of every lead they sent.

3. Diary management

  • Manage John's calendar in Outlook, booking 20 to 30 client appointments a week.
  • Confirm appointments, send reminders and reschedule no-shows.
  • Protect blocks of time for strategy work and broker meetings.

4. CRM and record keeping

  • Keep client records, file notes and documents complete and up to date in the licensee's CRM (Sustainable Life Solutions).
  • Make sure every client file meets the licensee's compliance standards.
  • Manage client documents in SharePoint and keep filing consistent.

5. Renewals and client retention

  • Prioritize clients ahead of their annual policy anniversary based on pre-determined criteria.
  • Flag premium increases, failed payments and lapse notices to John early. Early action protects clients' cover and reduces the risk of commission clawbacks.

6. Client service and policy changes

  • Respond promptly to client admin requests. These include address and payment detail changes, beneficiary updates, policy documents and premium queries.
  • Lodge policy alterations with insurers and confirm the outcome with clients.
  • Refer any question about what cover a client should have to John. The assistant does not give advice.

7. Marketing support

  • Post updates to Shield Life's social media channels.
  • Keep broker partner contact lists current.

8. General admin

  • Triage John's inbox and draft routine replies.
  • Help track commission statements against submitted business.
  • Document processes as they are learned so the business can scale.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • 3+ years in insurance administration, ideally in life insurance: Relevant roles include new business, underwriting support, policy servicing or adviser support.
  • Fluent in the language of insurance: The candidate should be confident with terms like underwriting requirements, exclusions, loadings, premiums, policy anniversaries and lapses.
  • Strong follow-through: The candidate chases outstanding items without being asked and closes the loop with clients, insurers and John.
  • Great attitude and a willingness to learn: The candidate should be positive and coachable, take ownership of their work, and be comfortable learning new systems and processes.
  • Microsoft 365: Confident with Outlook (including calendar management), Word, Excel, Teams and SharePoint.
  • Excellent written and spoken English: The candidate must be clear and professional with Australian clients over email and phone.
  • Detail and organisation: The candidate can manage many open cases at once with nothing slipping through the cracks.
  • Discretion: The candidate handles sensitive personal, medical, and financial information confidentially.

Desirable skills

  • Australian life insurance experience: This could be within an Australian risk advice, financial planning, mortgage broking or SMSF practice.
  • Australian insurer platforms: Experience with retail insurer adviser portals and online application systems.
  • Adviser CRM systems: Experience with platforms such as Xplan, AdviserLogic or a licensee CRM.
  • Mailchimp: Experience building, scheduling and reporting on email campaigns.
  • Social media: Experience posting business updates on LinkedIn and Facebook, and using a scheduling tool.
  • Basic design tools such as Canva for newsletter and social graphics.
  • Australian privacy awareness: An understanding of Australian privacy obligations when handling client information.
  • Ambition to grow: An interest in growing into a senior admin or team lead role as Shield Life adds advisers in 2027.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

This particular role is focused on Abbott’s Stroke Prevention offering which encompasses AmplatzerTM, AmuletTM and LAA Occluder.


The Clinical Specialist provides clinical and sales support through education of current and potential customers, and procedure coverage with a defined region. In this role, the Clinical Specialist with train interventional cardiologists, catheter lab staff and ancillary personnel on the use of Structural Heart products and provide technical support to physicians during procedures. The role is responsible for communicating product, clinical and market data to appropriate personnel and will support the company’s efforts to develop and implement product marketing strategies.


This position may be hired at different level, depending on the experience of the candidate. This position may travel in excess of 50%.

What You’ll Work On


· Collaborate with Territory Managers to provide good case coverage and clinical outcomes for patients.

· Serve as primary resource for clinical support in the areas of surgical coverage, troubleshooting and in-service education for company products.

· Educate customer on the merits and proper clinical usage of company products.

· Inform customers of the latest product, therapy and technology developments in the industry.

· Actively engage in clinical, procedural and technical discussions and link data outcome to key messaging.

· Meet with existing and potential clients (health care providers) to identify their clinical needs, goals and constraints related to patient care and provide creative and feasible solutions.

· This role requires a strong clinical orientation with the ability to influence a variety of clinician personality types.


Required Qualifications

· BS/BA or equivalent experience.

· 6+ years of related cardiovascular work experience.


Verification that you will satisfy all vendor credentialing requirements, which may include vaccination for COVID-19. If you require a medical or religious accommodation from these requirements or if you would like to understand more about these requirements, please advise HR so that we can provide additional information and if needed, we can explore any needed accommodation(s).


PreferredQualifications

· Degree in life sciences or medical training (RN, EMT, Perfusion, etc.).

· Strong clinical orientation, experience with products for use in interventional cardiology and cardiac surgery, familiarity with echo cardiology and other indirect imaging.

· Strong consideration will be given to candidates with EP (Electrophysiology) and SH (Structural Heart) sales experience.

This individual contributor role is 90% contracting and credentialing and 10% billing support. Day to day, the specialist submits provider enrollment applications, follows up with Medicaid and other payers, tracks deadlines across multiple client accounts, and answers client questions within a 24-hour SLA. Submissions take top priority because they start enrollment timelines that run from 30 days to 9 months. Success means on-time submissions, no stalled provider files, and clients who get status updates before they ask.

Contracting and Credentialing Operations

Billing Support

raw.description:
Chief Procurement Officer (CPO) – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Chief Procurement Officer (CPO) is responsible for developing and leading the organization's overall procurement, strategic sourcing, supplier management, purchasing, and procurement governance strategy. The role ensures that procurement activities support organizational objectives, deliver cost efficiencies, strengthen supplier relationships, mitigate procurement risks, and maximize value across the organization.

Within the Insurance & Investments sector, the CPO oversees the procurement of technology, professional services, operational resources, consulting, facilities, outsourced services, and other business-critical goods and services while ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, internal policies, financial controls, and organizational risk frameworks.

The CPO drives strategic sourcing, supplier performance, contract management, procurement transformation, cost optimization, and sustainable procurement practices.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Procurement Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and implement enterprise-wide procurement strategies aligned with corporate objectives and financial priorities.
  • Establish procurement policies, frameworks, operating models, standards, and governance structures.
  • Lead strategic sourcing, purchasing, procurement operations, and supplier management functions.
  • Identify opportunities to optimize procurement costs, improve purchasing efficiency, and maximize commercial value.
  • Align procurement priorities with business requirements, financial objectives, operational needs, and organizational strategy.

B. Strategic Sourcing & Supplier Selection

  • Lead strategic sourcing activities, supplier identification, market analysis, vendor evaluation, and competitive bidding.
  • Develop sourcing strategies for goods, services, technology, consulting, outsourcing, and business-critical procurement categories.
  • Oversee Request for Proposal (RFP), Request for Quotation (RFQ), tendering, supplier negotiations, and procurement decisions.
  • Evaluate suppliers based on cost, quality, service delivery, reliability, risk, innovation, and strategic value.
  • Establish strategic supplier partnerships and long-term commercial relationships.

C. Supplier & Vendor Relationship Management

  • Develop and maintain strategic relationships with key suppliers, vendors, service providers, and business partners.
  • Establish supplier performance management frameworks, service-level agreements (SLAs), and vendor review processes.
  • Monitor supplier performance, delivery quality, pricing, contractual obligations, and service effectiveness.
  • Manage supplier escalations, disputes, performance issues, and relationship risks.
  • Develop supplier diversification, contingency planning, and supplier continuity strategies.

D. Cost Optimization & Financial Management

  • Lead procurement cost optimization, savings initiatives, commercial negotiations, and expenditure management.
  • Develop procurement budgets, financial forecasts, spend plans, and procurement performance targets.
  • Identify cost-saving opportunities, purchasing efficiencies, spend consolidation, and supplier rationalization.
  • Monitor procurement expenditure, contract costs, purchasing trends, and budget performance.
  • Collaborate with Finance to validate savings, track financial benefits, and improve procurement value.
  • Ensure procurement decisions support financial sustainability, profitability, and effective resource allocation.

E. Contract Management & Commercial Negotiation

  • Lead commercial negotiations, procurement contracts, pricing agreements, and strategic vendor arrangements.
  • Establish contract management frameworks, approval processes, commercial controls, and procurement standards.
  • Ensure contracts align with business requirements, financial objectives, risk policies, and legal requirements.
  • Oversee contract renewals, amendments, supplier agreements, procurement terms, and contractual obligations.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Finance, Risk, Compliance, and business stakeholders to manage contract risks.

F. Procurement Governance, Risk & Compliance

  • Establish procurement governance frameworks, controls, approval structures, and accountability mechanisms.
  • Ensure procurement activities comply with internal policies, regulatory requirements, financial controls, and corporate governance standards.
  • Identify and mitigate supplier, operational, financial, contractual, reputational, and procurement risks.
  • Oversee procurement audits, documentation, sourcing approvals, supplier due diligence, and procurement transparency.
  • Coordinate with Risk, Compliance, Internal Audit, Legal, and Finance teams.
  • Ensure appropriate oversight of third-party risk, outsourcing arrangements, vendor security, and supplier resilience.

G. Procurement Transformation & Digitalization

  • Lead procurement transformation, modernization, process automation, and digital procurement initiatives.
  • Implement procurement technology, sourcing platforms, contract management systems, spend analytics, and supplier management solutions.
  • Improve procurement processes, workflows, reporting, approvals, and purchasing efficiency.
  • Drive data-driven procurement decision-making through spend analytics, supplier performance data, and procurement KPIs.
  • Promote innovation, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement across procurement activities.

H. Third-Party & Outsourcing Management

  • Oversee procurement and management of third-party providers, outsourced services, consultants, and strategic vendors.
  • Establish third-party risk assessment, supplier onboarding, due diligence, and monitoring frameworks.
  • Evaluate outsourcing arrangements, supplier dependencies, service continuity, and contractual performance.
  • Ensure third-party relationships align with operational resilience, regulatory, security, and business continuity requirements.
  • Manage strategic vendor partnerships and critical supplier relationships.

I. Leadership & Procurement Team Development

  • Lead, develop, and mentor procurement directors, sourcing managers, purchasing teams, contract managers, and procurement professionals.
  • Establish procurement performance expectations, team objectives, competency frameworks, and accountability standards.
  • Build high-performing procurement teams and strengthen organizational procurement capabilities.
  • Develop succession planning, leadership development, and procurement talent strategies.
  • Promote ethical procurement, collaboration, transparency, commercial excellence, and continuous improvement.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline.
  • MBA, Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Finance, or Business Management is highly preferred.
  • Professional procurement certifications such as CIPS, CPSM, CSCP, or equivalent are advantageous.

Professional Experience

  • 12–15+ years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, supply chain management, vendor management, or commercial management.
  • At least 5+ years in senior procurement leadership, director-level, or executive procurement roles.
  • Proven experience leading enterprise procurement strategy, strategic sourcing, contract management, and supplier relationships.
  • Experience in insurance, banking, investments, financial services, or other regulated industries is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated experience managing procurement budgets, cost optimization, supplier performance, commercial negotiations, and procurement teams.
  • Experience managing complex procurement categories, including technology, IT services, professional services, consulting, outsourcing, and operational services.
  • Proven track record of delivering measurable cost savings, procurement efficiencies, and commercial value.
  • Experience engaging with CEOs, CFOs, COOs, executive leadership, and senior business stakeholders.

Technical & Leadership Competencies

  • Enterprise procurement strategy and leadership.
  • Strategic sourcing and supplier selection.
  • Contract negotiation and commercial management.
  • Procurement governance, controls, and compliance.
  • Spend analysis, cost optimization, and financial management.
  • Supplier relationship and vendor performance management.
  • Third-party risk and outsourcing management.
  • Procurement transformation and digitalization.
  • Procurement technology and spend analytics.
  • Stakeholder management and executive leadership.
  • Team development, negotiation, and strategic decision-making.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Procurement cost savings and cost avoidance.

- Procurement spend under management.

  • Strategic sourcing effectiveness and supplier competitiveness.
  • Contract compliance and procurement governance.
  • Supplier performance and service quality.
  • Procurement cycle time and purchasing efficiency.
  • Procurement budget adherence and financial performance.
  • Supplier risk management and third-party compliance.
  • Procurement process automation and digital adoption.
  • Strategic supplier relationship performance.
  • Procurement team productivity and capability development.
  • Value realization from procurement and commercial initiatives.

raw.description:
About CG Oncology, Inc.

Are you ready to make a difference in the world and become part of our patient-centered team that is focused on Attacking Bladder Cancer for a Better Tomorrow? At CG Oncology, we believe that by having exceptionally talented individuals on our team who share our passion and enjoy working together, we can truly achieve our Vision and Mission to benefit patients around the world.

Every day we are making significant advancements across our multiple pipelines and are growing rapidly to meet the needs of our patients who cannot afford to wait to benefit from our novel immunotherapies. Please review this job posting and our Values and if they resonate with you and are what you expect from your organization and team, then we would like to hear from you.

About the role

The Senior Director, Field Medical Affairs is the people and strategic leader of CG Oncology's Medical Science Liaison (MSL) organization. This role builds, develops, inspires, and leads a high-performing field medical team that serves as a trusted scientific interface between CG Oncology and the external medical community. Success requires exceptional people leadership, emotional intelligence, active listening, and the ability to create alignment, accountability, and trust across a geographically dispersed field organization.

As a key member of the Medical Affairs Leadership Team, the Senior Director develops and executes an insight-driven field medical strategy supporting clinical development, launch readiness, and CG Oncology's transition to a commercial-stage oncology company. The role partners closely with Clinical Development, Commercial, Marketing, Market Access, Regulatory Affairs, Medical Information, Compliance, and Executive Leadership while maintaining clear Medical/Commercial guardrails, scientific independence, and the highest standards of scientific rigor, integrity, and compliance.

The Senior Director is accountable for MSL team performance, leadership and talent development, scientific engagement strategy, KOL development, medical insights generation and translation, field operations, and organizational effectiveness. This leader translates enterprise priorities into clear field strategy and ensures how results are achieved reflects CG Oncology's values and leadership behaviors.

Essential Functions

Strategic & People Leadership

  • Develop and execute Field Medical Affairs strategy aligned with Medical Affairs, clinical development, launch readiness, and corporate objectives.
  • Lead, coach, mentor, and develop a high-performing national MSL organization; create clarity, accountability, trust, and strong team cohesion.
  • Translate enterprise priorities into clear scientific objectives, priorities, KPIs, and measures of impact.
  • Create alignment through transparent communication, active listening, clear decision-making, and disciplined follow-through.
  • Anticipate evolving needs as CG operates simultaneously as a clinical and emerging commercial organization.
  • Build connection across a remote field organization through intentional communication, in-person engagement, recognition, and consistent leadership presence.

Field Medical & Scientific Leadership

  • Oversee field-based scientific exchange with healthcare professionals, investigators, and KOLs.
  • Ensure balanced, accurate, and compliant scientific information regarding CG Oncology products, pipeline assets, and disease-state education.
  • Lead advisory boards, investigator meetings, scientific congress activities, medical education programs, and other field medical initiatives.
  • Guide strategic KOL identification, development, and engagement aligned to prioritized scientific objectives.
  • Maintain uncompromising scientific rigor while helping MSLs translate complex science into clear, relevant, and credible scientific exchange.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Enterprise Alignment

  • Build trusted partnerships with Clinical Development, Commercial, Marketing, Market Access, Medical Information, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Operations, Compliance, and Pharmacovigilance.
  • Serve as a proactive bridge between Field Medical and Commercial leadership, ensuring coordinated planning, mutual respect for functional roles, appropriate information sharing, and clear Medical/Commercial guardrails.
  • Use scientific rigor, external insights, and enterprise judgment to influence strategy; respectfully challenge assumptions and help cross-functional teams reach aligned decisions.
  • Partner with Commercial and launch teams to understand evolving customer and market needs while preserving Medical Affairs scientific independence and compliance.
  • Model CG Oncology's Patient-Centered, Integrity, Collaboration, Innovation, Perseverance, and Well-Being values and leadership behaviors, including respectful disagreement, ownership, accountability, intellectual honesty, and assuming positive intent.

Medical Insights & Strategy

  • Establish processes for collecting, analyzing, prioritizing, and communicating field medical insights.
  • Translate external feedback into actionable recommendations informing clinical development, evidence generation, publication planning, Medical Affairs, and appropriate enterprise strategy.
  • Synthesize complex field information into concise, solution-oriented recommendations and a preferred path forward.
  • Monitor scientific advances, competitive intelligence, and treatment landscape changes to support forward-looking decisions.

Talent Management & Culture

  • Recruit, develop, and retain exceptional MSL talent.

  • Understanding of NoSQL, vector and graph databases (e.g., Cassandra, Qdrant, pgvector, Neo4j) and their role in AI knowledge management
  • Experience with cloud-native architectures and certified expertise in AWS, Azure, or GCP AI/ML services
  • Exposure to research or innovation projects, with publications or open-source contributions considered an advantage

What’s in it for you?

  • Regular salary reviews based on performance
  • Corporate events: webinars, offline parties, and meetups
  • Internal Mobility Program
  • Tailored education path (including full access to Udemy, certifications, etc.)
  • 25 paid days off: 20 business days of vacation per calendar year + 5 undocumented sick leave days
  • Additional health insurance
  • 100% company-covered Multisport card, with discounts available for family members

About us:

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

Since expanding to Bulgaria in 2022, we’ve been building a fast-growing team that thrives on learning, collaboration, and innovation. Join us on this exciting journey and help shape the future of our delivery center.

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

Alongside partners with organizations to drive digital transformation and build high-performing tech teams.

Our client is a leading digital healthcare and telemedicine company, enabling patients to receive medical advice and, at the doctor’s discretion, prescriptions and sick notes directly through the app.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to shape the patient experience across iOS, Android and web, building intuitive experiences that keep patients engaged and coming back. Working alongside an Engineering Manager, a Product Designer and nine engineers, including QA, you’ll own the roadmap from discovery through delivery and iteration.

Responsabilities:

  • Own and prioritise the Patient Experience roadmap, with a focus on engagement, retention and patient satisfaction.
  • Identify patient needs and opportunities through user feedback, product data and market insights.
  • Lead end-to-end discovery, turning ambiguous problems into clear, validated concepts ready for implementation.
  • Use prototypes, including AI-assisted prototypes, to explore solutions and validate ideas quickly.
  • Design and analyse experiments, define success criteria, and use evidence to guide rollout, iteration or rollback decisions.
  • Collaborate with engineering and design to deliver high-quality experiences across mobile and web.
  • Partner with Patient Growth, Patient Partnerships and Doctor Experience teams to improve end-to-end patient journeys.
  • Continuously improve the team’s discovery and delivery processes.
  • Keep stakeholders aligned through clear written communication and documentation.

Requirements

  • Several years of Product Management experience with B2C consumer products, ideally in healthcare or e-commerce.
  • A strong track record of improving product experience, engagement and retention.
  • Experience leading product discovery, defining strategy and translating complex problems into actionable solutions.
  • Hands-on experience designing, running and analysing product experiments.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience with tools such as Metabase, Mixpanel or similar.
  • Experience working on native iOS and Android apps, alongside an understanding of React-based web applications and platform constraints.
  • Practical experience using AI in product work, including discovery or prototyping.
  • Strong product judgement, attention to detail and a focus on intuitive user experiences.
  • Experience improving discovery and delivery processes within a cross-functional product team.
  • Excellent written communication and documentation skills in a remote working environment.
  • Fluency in English.

Benefits

  • Fully remote working arrangement.
  • Initial three-month contract, starting in January.
  • Ownership of the product roadmap, from discovery through experimentation and delivery.
  • Close collaboration with a dedicated Engineering Manager, Product Designer and nine engineers, including QA.
  • Work across iOS, Android and web, using AI and experimentation to solve meaningful patient problems.

raw.excerpt: Bold Nuestra compañía fue fundada en Mayo de 2019 por un equipo de personas increíbles y con una experiencia única, el grupo de fundadores está conformado por los creadores de PayU Latam y otras empresas expertas en tecnología financiera.
raw.description:
Bold

Nuestra compañía fue fundada en Mayo de 2019 por un equipo de personas increíbles y con una experiencia única, el grupo de fundadores está conformado por los creadores de PayU Latam y otras empresas expertas en tecnología financiera. Estamos creando soluciones de pago y de banca para MiPymes, independientes y emprendedores en Colombia. Actualmente contamos con más de 450.000 clientes registrados en nuestra plataforma y hemos recibido más de USD $120 millones de fondos de inversión nacionales y extranjeros, somos una de las startups de más rápido crecimiento en LatAm en el sector fintech. Bold es una fintech que provee una solución de pagos a los microempresarios para recibir pagos con tarjetas débito, crédito y billeteras a través de datáfonos y links de pago. Sin embargo, la visión de Bold es más ambiciosa que ser una empresa de pagos y estamos trabajando para volvernos una plataforma de servicios financieros y tecnológicos para las pequeñas empresas en el país complementando las soluciones de pagos y banca con otros productos de software conexos a toda nuestra propuesta de valor. Nuestra misión en Bold es liberar el potencial de los emprendedores. En Bold creemos firmemente que podemos ayudar a los pequeños emprendedores a desarrollar sus negocios ofreciendo servicios financieros y tecnológicos hechos a su medida, que sean amigables y cercanos. En Bold definimos los siguientes valores como los pilares de nuestra cultura organizacional: Maestría, Pensamiento crítico, Trabajo en equipo, Sentido de urgencia, Somos abiertos y el cliente el centro de lo que hacemos. Para más información acerca de Bold visita nuestro sitio web:

El Rol:

El Design System Manager define y lidera la estrategia del design system de Bold, para que diseñadores, ingenieros y agentes de AI construyan productos consistentes, accesibles y muy intuitivos a partir de una única fuente de verdad.

Lidera un equipo multidisciplinario de UX, UI e ingeniería. Su reto es que el sistema exista en Figma y en código, sincronizado de punta a punta, que su adopción en la organización sea medible y que sus componentes y reglas sean legibles tanto para personas como para agentes de AI.

Responsabilidades:

Estrategia y visión

  • Definir la visión, el roadmap y las prioridades del design system de Bold, alineados con los objetivos de producto y de negocio.

  • Establecer principios, gobernanza y criterios de contribución: qué entra al sistema, quién decide y cómo se versiona.

  • Diseñar el sistema para que lo consuman personas y agentes de AI por igual: tokens, componentes y documentación estructurados, semánticos y legibles por máquina.

Liderazgo del equipo

  • Gestionar y desarrollar al equipo de design system: diseño UX, diseño UI e ingeniería de desarrollo.

  • Planificar capacidad, priorizar el backlog y asegurar entregas con calidad y consistencia.

  • Coordinar con los equipos de producto, diseño e ingeniería (web y app) como socio, no como área de soporte.

Librería de componentes

  • Crear y mantener la librería de componentes en diseño (Figma) y en código, con paridad entre ambas.

  • Garantizar accesibilidad, rendimiento, responsive y documentación de uso (UI y UX) en cada componente.

  • Gestionar tokens de diseño (color, tipografía, espaciado, motion) como base común de ambos mundos.

Adopción medible

  • Lograr que los diseñadores UX construyan prototipos con los componentes UI del sistema.

  • Lograr que los ingenieros front de web y app construyan los productos con el código de los componentes.

  • Definir y seguir métricas de adopción (por ejemplo, % de pantallas y productos que usan componentes del DS, cobertura de componentes, desviaciones, tiempo de entrega) y usarlas para priorizar mejoras.

  • Dar soporte, formación y comunicación continua para impulsar el uso en toda la organización.

Flujo de trabajo end to end diseño a código

  • Ser dueño del flujo completo: toda actualización de UI o UX en el DS debe reflejarse en el repositorio de componentes en código.

  • Implementar pipelines de versionado, publicación y pruebas (incluidas pruebas visuales y de accesibilidad) que permitan a los productos actualizarse a nuevas versiones de forma automática.

  • Gestionar cambios importantes, deprecaciones y comunicación de versiones para no romper los productos.

¿Qué tenemos para ti?

👨🏽‍⚕️ Auxilio de salud.

🚀 Bono anual por cumplimiento de objetivos empresariales (acciones o dinero).

🤝 Contrato a término indefinido.

💲 Salario competitivo.

👩🏿‍💻 Trabajo remoto 100%.

📚 Apoyo económico para educación.

🌎 Tecnologías y procesos de clase mundial.

🏖️ Días libres adicionales a las vacaciones.

Requirements

Experiencia requerida

  • 3 a 6 años o más en product management, ingeniería front-end o design systems, con al menos 2 años liderando equipos.

  • Portafolio o casos que muestren resultados medibles de adopción y de impacto en velocidad o consistencia.

Habilidades técnicas

  • Dominio de Figma: componentes, variables, tokens, variantes y librerías compartidas.

  • Conocimiento sólido de front-end: HTML, CSS, TypeScript, React y desarrollo de librerías de componentes (también deseable conocimiento de desarrollo móvil).

  • Gestión de tokens y su automatización del diseño al código (por ejemplo, Style Dictionary o Tokens Studio).

  • Pipelines de CI/CD, versionado semántico, publicación de paquetes y pruebas (unitarias, visuales y de accesibilidad).

  • Documentación de componentes (por ejemplo, Storybook) y accesibilidad (WCAG).

  • Comprensión de cómo trabajan los agentes de AI con sistemas de diseño: documentación y metadatos legibles por máquina, MCP, reglas y guías que un agente pueda seguir para generar UI correcta.

Gestión y liderazgo

  • Liderazgo de equipos multidisciplinarios de diseño e ingeniería, con capacidad de desarrollar y dar feedback.

  • Pensamiento estratégico y de producto: tratar el design system como un producto interno con usuarios, roadmap y métricas.

  • Definición y seguimiento de métricas de adopción y calidad, con decisiones basadas en datos.

  • Gestión de gobernanza y procesos de contribución en organizaciones con muchos equipos.

Aptitudes y habilidades blandas

  • Influencia sin autoridad: capacidad de convencer a equipos de producto, diseño e ingeniería de adoptar el sistema.

  • Comunicación clara con perfiles de diseño y de ingeniería, y habilidad para negociar prioridades.

  • Mentalidad de servicio, colaboración y orientación a resultados.

  • Criterio para equilibrar consistencia y flexibilidad, y calidad frente a velocidad.

  • Curiosidad y adaptabilidad frente a la evolución rápida de la AI y de las herramientas de diseño.

Deseable

  • Experiencia en fintech, pagos o productos con alto volumen transaccional.

  • Experiencia previa habilitando herramientas de AI o agentes en flujos de diseño y desarrollo.

  • Experiencia con marcos de trabajo multimarca o multiplataforma.

En Bold, el talento no tiene etiquetas. Fomentamos un entorno de trabajo inclusivo y accesible para todos, garantizando un proceso de selección equitativo. Si necesitas algún ajuste razonable para participar en el proceso, por favor infórmanos al postularte.

Autorización de Tratamiento de Datos Personales

Como Titular de Datos Personales, te asisten los derechos previstos en la Ley 1581 de 2012 y demás normas que la complementen o modifiquen, en especial, los derechos a conocer, actualizar, rectificar o solicitar la supresión de tus datos, y revocar la autorización que has otorgado para el uso de tus Datos Personales. raw.excerpt: Um dos maiores grupos de beleza do mundo, o Grupo Boticário é uma empresa brasileira presente em mais de 40 países.
raw.description:
Um dos maiores grupos de beleza do mundo, o Grupo Boticário é uma empresa brasileira presente em mais de 40 países. É dono das marcas O Boticário, Eudora, Quem Disse, Berenice?, Vult, O.U.i, Dr. JONES, Tô.que.tô, TRUSS, e do marketplace Beleza na Web, além de atuar com produtos licenciados como Australian Gold, Bio Oil, Nuxe, e Pampers e sua divisão para o mercado B2B. Essa interação entre diferentes marcas, ativos, plataformas, rede de franqueados, representantes, distribuidores, varejistas, sellers e fornecedores formam o ecossistema de beleza do Grupo Boticário que oferece, ainda, soluções digitais de gestão de negócio para o varejo brasileiro por meio das suas marcas Mooz, Casa Magalhães e GAVB. São mais de 19 mil colaboradores diretos, com mais de 4 mil lojas em 1.780 cidades brasileiras.

Vem fazer beleza com a gente!

Sobre o Desafio

Você atuará na Squad de Ingestão e Motor de Regras do GPlan, nosso produto desenvolvido para revolucionar o planejamento e a previsão de demanda da companhia. Seu desafio será desenvolver e evoluir soluções de ponta a ponta em um ecossistema orientado a eventos (Kafka e arquiteturas de replicação/CDC), estruturando a ingestão de dados, regras de negócio de alta complexidade e a persistência em cloud AWS (Serverless, EKS, RDS e evolução para Data Lake com S3 e Iceberg), atuando de forma Full Stack com foco em Back-end (Kotlin) e interface em React.

Como será o seu dia a dia?

  • Construir e evoluir a ingestão de dados via Kafka (Amazon MSK), consumindo dados analíticos vindos do GCP para a AWS.
  • Modelar, manipular e otimizar dados em PostgreSQL (Amazon RDS), com SQL avançado e stored procedures.
  • Aplicar regras de negócio aos dados, incluindo a implementação de motores de regras.
  • Atuar no roteamento e na distribuição de dados via eventos e arquitetura Apache Iceberg.
  • Participar dos refinamentos técnicos, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em soluções, mesmo quando o contexto ainda não está todo definido.
  • Garantir a qualidade do que entrega: testes unitários, atenção a métricas e vulnerabilidades e revisão de código dos colegas.
  • Usar IA no dia a dia de desenvolvimento (somos um time IA First), com olhar crítico sobre o que ela entrega.
O que você precisa ter ou saber?
  • Experiência sólida como pessoa desenvolvedora FullStack (com foco principal em Back-end, atuando preferencialmente na construção de produtos digitais.
  • Linguagens & Back-end: Forte conhecimento em Kotlin e/ou Java para construção de consumidores/produtores de alta performance.
  • Front-end: Conhecimento em React para atuações pontuais no front-end.
  • Vivência prática com Kafka ou outras arquiteturas orientadas a eventos, replicação de dados e CDC (como Kinesis, RabbitMQ ou SQS).
  • Domínio de PostgreSQL (RDS) e SQL avançado, com experiência em stored procedures.
  • Experiência com AWS (especialmente Serverless e EKS/Kubernetes).
  • Prática com testes automatizados e qualidade de código.
  • Facilidade para transitar entre técnica e negócio, com visão sistêmica.
  • Adaptabilidade, proatividade, perfil propositivo e conforto com ambientes em construção.

Será um diferencial

  • Experiência com Data Lake na AWS (S3), Apache Iceberg, Lakehouse ou outras arquiteturas de dados modernas.
  • Vivência com supply chain, planejamento de demanda ou S&OP.
  • Experiência com motores de regras.
  • Uso de ferramentas de IA para desenvolvimento (como Cursor ou similares), com forte pensamento crítico e hábito de revisão de código.

Informações adicionais

Benefícios que cuidam e se diferenciam:

No Grupo Boticário, o cuidado é a nossa base para atingirmos resultados exponenciais. Temos um portfólio com mais de 20 benefícios para cuidar da sua saúde, bem estar e família. Confira abaixo.

Saúde:

  • Plano médico e odontológico flexíveis
  • Auxílio medicamentos e vale saúde para familiares
  • Sessões de psicoterapia gratuitas e telemedicina 24h
  • Programas contínuos de prevenção, cuidado mental e vacinação

Alimentação & bem-estar

  • Vale Refeição (ou restaurante local) e Vale Alimentação (com vale extra no Natal)
  • Desconto de até 40% nas marcas do nosso ecossistema
  • Gympass/TotalPass para academias e estúdios esportivos
  • Auxílio Home Office para modalidades híbrida e remota
  • Day off de aniversário para celebrar do seu jeito
  • Plano de saúde pet, vantagens em convênios e programas de viagem/hospedagem

Para sua família

  • Licença parental estendida (180 dias para mães e 120 dias para pais)
  • Suporte para Pais Atípicos e auxílio babá / educação infantil
  • Auxílio material escolar e crédito nutrição infantil
  • Orientação jurídica, psicológica e social dedicada

Seguridade para proteção e tranquilidade financeira

  • Previdência Privada e Seguro de Vida
  • Apoio ao falecimento de pais e empréstimo consignado
  • Vale Transporte e Estacionamento (conforme o modelo de trabalho)

Nota: Os pacotes de benefícios são adaptados de acordo com a elegibilidade de cada cargo e modelo de trabalho.

raw.description:
Poznaj Onwelo

Onwelo jest partnerem technologicznym, który dostarcza kompleksowe usługi, od strategii i architektury, przez wdrożenia, po utrzymanie, w obszarach transformacji cyfrowej, danych i automatyzacji. Nasz zespół liczy ponad 400 specjalistów z silnymi kompetencjami seniorskim, a na koncie mamy 300+ zrealizowanych projektów dla dużych organizacji w Polsce, Europie i USA. Działamy z kilku polskich miast oraz z biur w Niemczech, Szwajcarii i USA, łącząc lokalną obecność z globalnym zasięgiem.

O projekcie

Do naszego zespołu Security Operations Center (SOC) poszukujemy SOC Analyst Tier 1, który będzie odpowiedzialny za monitorowanie bezpieczeństwa infrastruktury IT oraz pierwszą linię reagowania na incydenty bezpieczeństwa.

Twoje zadania

  • Analiza alertów i logów oraz dokonywanie wstępnej klasyfikacji incydentów

  • Eskalowanie incydentów do zespołów Tier 2 / Tier 3

  • Opisywanie zdarzeń i dokumentowanie ich w systemie

  • Podłączanie nowych źródeł logów (np. serwery, aplikacje, urządzenia sieciowe)

  • Sprawdzanie, czy logi są poprawnie zbierane i czy dane mają sens

  • Tworzenie i poprawianie reguł alertów

  • Pomoc w utrzymaniu porządku w monitoringu i ograniczać liczbę fałszywych alarmów

Kogo szukamy

  • Posiadasz podstawową wiedzę z zakresu cyberbezpieczeństwa

  • Znasz zagadnienia: sieci (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP), systemów Windows/Linux

  • Umiejętnie analizujesz logi i zdarzenia bezpieczeństwa

  • Znasz narzędzia Elasticsearch, Terraform, Ansible

  • Wykazujesz się zdolnością do pracy zmianowej

  • Komunikujesz się w języku angielskim min. na poziomie b2

  • Wykazujesz się chęcią nauki i rozwoju w obszarze cyberbezpieczeństwa

Co oferujemy

  • Elastyczne godzinyoraz możliwość pracy hybrydowej lub zdalnej

  • Udział w ciekawych projektach dla globalnych klientów

  • Aż 80% awansów w naszej firmie odbywa się wewnętrznie

  • 90% kadry zarządzającej ma wykształcenie techniczne

  • Dostęp do szkoleń wewnętrznych i ścieżek rozwojowych

  • Udział w wydarzeniach zespołowych, firmowych spotkaniach i Town Hallach

  • Wsparcie w budowaniu profesjonalnego wizerunku (personal branding)

  • Dostęp do ubezpieczenia na życie oraz prywatnej opieki medycznej dla siebie i rodziny

  • Karta MultiSport, która wspiera dbałość o zdrowie i kondycję

raw.description:
Als Planner en Werkvoorbereider Service en Onderhoud bij MUR Conditioning in Utrecht zorg jij ervoor dat monteurs efficiënt en goed voorbereid op pad gaan!

Je bewaakt de planning, houdt overzicht en zorgt dat klanten kunnen rekenen op snelle en professionele service.

In deze rol als Planner en Werkvoorbereider Service en Onderhoud ben jij de verbindende schakel tussen klanten, monteurs en kantoor. Dankzij jouw organisatiekracht en communicatie verlopen service- en onderhoudswerkzaamheden soepel en volgens planning.

Wat wij je bieden

  • Salaris boven de cao-inschaling, afgestemd op jouw ervaring

  • 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om 8 dagen bij te kopen

  • Pensioen volgens cao Technisch Installatiebedrijf bij PMT

  • Opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden via MUR zoals certificeringen

  • Toegang tot voordelen via de VDK app met kortingen op verzekeringen, brandstof, attracties, corporate benefits en nog veel meer.

  • Een gezellige en informele werksfeer met regelmatig leuke uitjes en attenties, barbecues, jubileumfeesten en daarnaast de jaarlijkse VDK-familiefeesten zoals Phantasialand!

Wat ga je doen

Als Planner en Werkvoorbereider Service en Onderhoud zorg jij voor structuur binnen een dynamische werkomgeving.

  • Efficiënt plannen van monteurs, onderaannemers, materialen en hulpmiddelen

  • Bewaken van voortgang, urenregistratie en planningen

  • Overleggen met monteurs, kantoor en directie

  • Aannemen en afhandelen van storingen, klachten en klantvragen

  • Signaleren van meerwerk en adviseren over oplossingen

  • Meedenken over contractverlengingen en verbeteringen

Wat neem je mee

  • Mbo 4+ of hbo werk- en denkniveau

  • Ervaring als planner of werkvoorbereider in een technische omgeving

  • Affiniteit met koel-, klimaat- of installatietechniek

  • Ervaring met Syntess is een grote pré

  • Stressbestendig en sterk organiserend

  • Communicatief vaardig en klantgericht

Vink je niet alles af maar heb je wel de ambitie? Dan komen we ook graag met je in contact.

MUR Conditioning & de VDK Groep

MUR Conditioning is een Utrechts familiebedrijf met meer dan 50 jaar ervaring in koel- en klimaattechniek. Met ruim 70 vakmensen realiseren en onderhouden zij duurzame koel-, vries- en klimaatsystemen voor onder andere hotels, retail, horeca en utiliteit. Wat MUR Conditioning onderscheidt, is de combinatie van technische vakkennis, korte lijnen en een 24/7 servicementaliteit. Geen standaardoplossingen, maar slimme maatwerkinstallaties waar kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid en persoonlijk contact centraal staan.

Wij zijn een trots onderdeel van de snelgroeiende VDK Groep, maar opereren met een eigen identiteit en cultuur. Je voelt je thuis bij MUR, terwijl je kunt bouwen op de kracht van de VDK Groep. Dit betekent; Grote voordelen zoals stabiliteit, volop opleidingskansen, doorgroeimogelijkheden en veel extra secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden! raw.excerpt: The Red Hat Product Security team is looking for a Senior Product Security Engineer focused on vulnerability triage and analysis to join us remotely or onsite in one of the following countries: the Czech Republic, Ireland, or Portugal.
raw.description:
The Red Hat Product Security team is looking for a Senior Product Security Engineer focused on vulnerability triage and analysis to join us remotely or onsite in one of the following countries: the Czech Republic, Ireland, or Portugal.


In this role, you will be a key security engineer primarily focused on vulnerability triage, risk analysis, and mitigation across Red Hat's product portfolio. You will assess incoming vulnerabilities, determine severity and impact, and work closely with engineering teams to guide remediation efforts. Over time, you will also have the option to expand your focus into delivery pipeline security, helping build secure automation and integrate security controls into our CI/CD systems.


What you will do

  • Triage incoming security vulnerabilities reported across Red Hat products and software supply chain dependencies.
  • Analyze root causes, determine flaw severity (CVSS), evaluate real-world risk, and advise product teams on remediation strategies.
  • Perform static and dynamic security analysis (SAST/DAST) to validate potential vulnerabilities and verify fix effectiveness.
  • Collaborate with development teams and product security engineers to streamline security disclosure and advisory processes.
  • Expand into delivery pipeline security, contributing to automated scanning and security gates within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Enhance AI-driven and agentic workflows to increase precision in vulnerability triage and analysis.
  • Improve internal tooling and workflows to increase overall automation and enhance usability for fellow engineers.
  • Proactively identify new opportunities for automation to reduce manual effort, improve security coverage, and secure our software supply chain.
  • Work with upstream open source communities to contribute to, and leverage, new and existing security tooling.
  • Document the automation you build to ensure it is maintainable, well-understood, and usable by the wider team.

What you will bring

  • Proven experience in security vulnerability triage, flaw analysis, CVSS scoring, and threat modeling.
  • A solid understanding of one or more scripting or programming languages (like Python, Go, or Bash).
  • Interest or experience in delivery pipeline security and CI/CD tools (like Tekton, Jenkins, or Ansible) is a plus.
  • A good understanding of Linux fundamentals and how to operate in a Linux-based environment.
  • Knowledge of container technologies (like Docker, Kubernetes, or Red Hat OpenShift) and their security considerations.
  • Strong understanding of common vulnerability classes, exploit techniques, and secure coding practices.
  • Experience using AI-powered tools (like code assistants or analysis tools) to improve your workflow is a plus.
  • The ability to work independently, manage your own tasks, and provide technical guidance to more junior team members.

About Red Hat

Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterpriseopen source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.

Inclusion at Red Hat
Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.

Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)
Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.


Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.


Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email . General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.

Executive Assistant (EA)

Executive Support | Calendar Management | Travel Coordination | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours (Flexibility Required)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a highly organized and proactive Executive Assistant (EA) to provide strategic administrative and operational support to senior leadership.

This is more than a traditional administrative role. You’ll serve as a trusted partner, helping executives stay focused on high-impact priorities by managing calendars, coordinating travel, handling executive communications, preparing meetings, and ensuring projects and follow-ups move forward seamlessly.

If you thrive in fast-paced environments, anticipate needs before they arise, and excel at keeping executives organized and productive, this role is an excellent opportunity.

What You’ll Own

Calendar & Scheduling Management

  • Manage complex executive calendars across multiple time zones.
  • Coordinate meetings, calls, travel, and scheduling priorities.
  • Resolve scheduling conflicts and optimize executive availability.
  • Utilize Google Calendar, Microsoft Outlook, Calendly, and related scheduling tools.
  • Ensure executives are fully prepared for upcoming meetings and commitments.

Executive Communication & Support

  • Draft, proofread, and send professional emails and executive communications.
  • Manage executive inboxes, prioritizing urgent requests and correspondence.
  • Screen calls, messages, and meeting requests.
  • Serve as a liaison between executives, clients, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion.

Meeting Preparation & Follow-Up

  • Prepare meeting agendas, briefing documents, presentations, and talking points.
  • Gather and organize supporting materials before meetings.
  • Take meeting notes, document action items, and track follow-ups.
  • Ensure deadlines, priorities, and deliverables remain on schedule.

Travel & Logistics Coordination

  • Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements.
  • Book flights, hotels, transportation, and complete travel itineraries.
  • Manage last-minute schedule changes and travel adjustments.
  • Track travel expenses and assist with reimbursements.
  • Ensure seamless travel logistics for executives.

Project & Administrative Support

  • Track executive priorities, projects, and ongoing initiatives.
  • Follow up with internal teams to ensure deliverables and deadlines are met.
  • Conduct research and prepare reports, summaries, and briefing materials.
  • Maintain organized digital filing systems and documentation.
  • Support operational initiatives and special projects as assigned.

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

Experience

  • 3+ years of Executive Assistant or senior administrative support experience.
  • Experience supporting executives in fast-paced business environments.
  • Proven experience managing complex calendars across multiple time zones.
  • Experience coordinating executive travel and logistics.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency with Google Workspace and Microsoft Office.
  • Strong experience using calendar and scheduling tools.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Outstanding organizational, multitasking, and time management abilities.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information professionally.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience supporting startups, agencies, consulting firms, or high-growth organizations.
  • Familiarity with Slack, Zoom, Notion, Asana, ClickUp, or similar collaboration platforms.
  • Experience supporting multiple executives simultaneously.
  • Exposure to operations, project coordination, or business support functions.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Exceptionally organized with outstanding attention to detail.
  • Proactive and able to anticipate executive needs.
  • Strong communicator who builds trust across teams and stakeholders.
  • Calm under pressure and adaptable to changing priorities.
  • Highly dependable with excellent follow-through.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review executive calendars and prepare daily briefing notes.
  • Manage inboxes, scheduling requests, and executive communications.
  • Coordinate meetings, agendas, and follow-up actions.
  • Arrange travel plans and manage logistics.
  • Track project updates and ensure priorities stay on schedule.
  • Prepare reports, summaries, and next-day planning materials.

In short: You enable executives to operate at peak efficiency by managing schedules, communication, travel, and operational priorities with accuracy and professionalism.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Calendar accuracy and scheduling efficiency.
  • Timely communication and follow-up completion.
  • Executive satisfaction with operational support.
  • Smooth travel coordination and logistics management.
  • Reduction in scheduling conflicts and administrative delays.
  • Accuracy and organization of executive documentation.

Why Join Us?

  • Fully remote opportunity aligned with U.S. business hours.
  • High-visibility role supporting senior leadership directly.
  • Opportunity to work closely with decision-makers and executives.
  • Fast-paced, collaborative, and growth-oriented environment.
  • Exposure to executive operations, strategic initiatives, and business management.
  • Career growth opportunities into Operations, Project Management, Chief of Staff, or Executive Operations roles.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Practical Assessment (Executive Briefing Memo or Scheduling Scenario)
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Background Verification

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the next step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps the hiring team evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

If you’re a proactive Executive Assistant who excels at managing executive priorities, coordinating complex schedules, and keeping operations running smoothly behind the scenes, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and become a trusted partner to senior leadership in a dynamic remote environment.

raw.title: Project Finance, Analyst
raw.excerpt: SolAmerica Energy is a private equity-backed firm who develops, builds, owns, and operates distributed generation (DG) solar projects and energy storage solutions.
raw.description:
SolAmerica Energy is a private equity-backed firm who develops, builds, owns, and operates distributed generation (DG) solar projects and energy storage solutions.

Based in Atlanta, Georgia, SolAmerica has successfully developed and built solar power projects throughout the eastern half of the United States and has a growing pipeline of project opportunities in more than 20 states.

SolAmerica is committed to advancing diversity, equity, and inclusion and believes in attracting, retaining, and advancing employees who will best serve and represent its customers, partners, and communities.

We promote fostering a work culture of mutual respect and teamwork, ensuring that everyone can grow and contribute at their greatest potential. For additional information about SolAmerica, visit .

Requirements

SolAmerica Energy is seeking an ambitious Analyst to help drive our capital raising and project valuation efforts. This role offers direct mentorship from senior leadership and deep, hands-on exposure to complex renewable energy financing structures, making it an ideal launchpad for a long-term career in the project finance space.

The candidate will support a variety of activities for the Project Finance group, including but not limited to:

  • Supporting all capital raising activities (including permanent and construction debt and tax credit monetization),
  • Working with Senior PF team members in building, preparing and maintaining project finance models, and
  • Contributing to analysis of new solar energy markets and programs
  • Supporting potential M&A opportunities.

The Analyst will be a key member of the company’s finance team, working closely within the Project Finance team to optimize the value of the company’s projects and identify strategic growth markets and opportunities for the company.

PRIMARY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support the Senior Project Finance team with all debt, tax equity and other project-level financing processes for the company’s solar and/or storage portfolios, including determining optimal project financing structures, working with lenders and investors, and negotiating financing agreements.
  • Assist in constructing and maintaining financial models and coordinating with internal and external stakeholders to enable a streamlined and consistent approach for investment decisions.
  • Coordinate with third-party consultants to ensure the timely delivery of Independent Engineer reports, appraisals, and insurance reports and other deliverables required for financing processes.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Business Development, Project Execution, Accounting, and Legal to integrate accurate data and clear messaging into all Project Finance deliverables (e.g., draw requests, recurring reports) for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Support senior team members in providing insights and detailed analysis for the valuation of project portfolios both owned and under development.
  • Support Business Development and Origination with PPA pricing and scenario analysis.
  • Establish and foster relationships with stakeholders across the Renewables and Energy Transition sectors to leverage industry contacts for future opportunities.
  • Assist with development activities related to optimizing the value of the company’s solar assets, including market research to refine the development model for a campaign, promotion of projects with officials in relevant jurisdictions, and pursuit of financial incentives for projects.
  • Work closely with Business Development and Origination teams to conduct market research and make go-to-market recommendations for the company.
  • Maintain comprehensive coverage of the company’s target markets, understanding current market conditions, rules and regulations, most important actors within each market, and other key economic factors influencing the company’s efforts in said markets.

EDUCATION & KNOWLEDGE

  • BA/BS required, ideally in a quantitative, business, or technical field.
  • Demonstrated experience with Excel spreadsheets, financial modeling and data analysis
  • Experience in investment banking, corporate finance, or project finance (renewable energy experience is a strong plus).
  • Minimum of 1-2 years of relevant working experience for Analyst; 3+ years for Senior Analyst
  • Familiarity with the development and diligence process required to successfully finance energy projects.
  • Familiarity with financial/accounting principles.
  • Familiarity with electricity industry players, economics, and trends.
  • Familiarity with solar industry basics and modeling tools (PVSyst, net metering and QF tariffs, etc.).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills and ability to interpret large amounts of information from various sources.
  • Positive attitude, high energy, supportive team member, problem solver, able to work in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

KEY SKILLS & COMPETENCIES

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Detail oriented and organized.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects under various deadlines.
  • Ability to use all available resources to conduct research.
  • Self-motivated with ability to work in a team and independently.
  • Safe driving record and valid driver’s license.
  • Up to 10% travel in support of the position responsibilities.

Benefits

Compensation and Benefits

SolAmerica Energy offers a competitive salary, benefits package and performance bonus opportunities with this position.

Our total rewards strategy is designed to support our employees to thrive professionally and personally while seeking to create a culture of work/life balance as we work toward our collective goals as a business.

We offer a monthly stipend to go towards communication expenses and all our health insurance benefits are effective from Day 1.

Third Party Agencies & Candidate Submissions

SolAmerica Energy will only consider candidates for this position while it is active. SolAmerica Energy will not consider unsolicited candidate applications from third-party agencies.

ポートフォリオレベニューディレクター　レストラン＆バーレベニューサービス担当（東京コーポレートオフィス所属、フルリモート）

East Asia Pacific (EAPAC)全域におけるRestaurants & Bars (R&B)レベニュー・サービスを統括し、ホテルおよび店舗のポートフォリオ全体にわたるR&Bレベニュー戦略と業績を推進する。本役職は、選定された複雑な案件を直接管理し、地域R&Bレベニュー・サービスチームを率いて育成するとともに、サービス提供範囲を拡大し、ホテルおよび地域のステークホルダーに対してR&Bレベニュー分野のシニアパートナーとしての役割を果たす。

主な職務内容：

  • EAPAC全域において、ホテル、レストラン、バー、スパ、およびその他の付帯レベニュー源からなるポートフォリオについて、R&Bレベニューサービスおよび収益戦略を統括する。
  • 選定された複雑または注目度の高いホテル案件を直接管理し、ホテルの経営陣に対してR&Bレベニュー分野のシニアパートナーとしての役割を果たす。
  • 需要、収容能力、価格設定、メニュー構成、プロモーション、顧客データを活用し、実践的な収益および収益性の向上機会を特定する。
  • ホテルおよび地域のステークホルダーと連携し、主要な業績指標、予測、予算、戦略のレビューを主導する。
  • F&B、オペレーション、財務、マーケティング、営業、デジタル各チームと連携し、提言を実行に移す。

サービスの拡大とステークホルダーとの連携：

  • 新規ホテルのビジネスチャンスを特定・獲得し、R&Bレベニューサービスの事業範囲を拡大する。
  • 説得力のあるビジネスケースを構築し、総支配人、オーナー、営業責任者らと連携して、本サービスの価値をアピールする。

• ホテルの導入を支援し、レベニューサービス運営モデルへの円滑な移行を確保する。

リーダーシップとチーム開発：

  • Portfolio Revenue Manager R&Bの同僚およびサポートチームメンバーに対し、リーダーシップ、コーチング、技術的な指導を提供する。
  • 複雑な業績、ステークホルダー、データ品質、導入に関する問題について、エスカレーション窓口としての役割を果たす。
  • R&Bレベニュー担当職の採用、オンボーディング、研修、人材開発、後継者計画を支援する。
  • ホテルのGM、F&Bリーダー、地域の営業チーム、オーナーと強固な関係を構築する。

効率性、データ、イノベーション：

  • 生産性とサービスの一貫性を高めるため、業務方法、報告体制、チームの日常業務を継続的に改善する。
  • 信頼性の高いデータの確保、明確な業績報告、および収益向上施策に対する厳格なフォローアップを徹底する。

学歴および経験：

  • ホスピタリティ、レベニューマネージメント、ビジネス、または関連分野における学士号、または同等の実務経験。
  • ホスピタリティ、レベニューマネージメント、商業戦略、またはF&B（フード＆ビバレッジ）分野における10年以上の段階的なリーダーシップ経験。
  • ホテル、クラスター、ポートフォリオ、または地域レベルにおいて、複雑なR&B（収益・予算）戦略を主導した経験。
  • チームを指導し、上級ステークホルダーに影響を与え、新たな商業サービスに対する支持を築くことができた実績。

技術的スキルおよび知識：

  • R&B（収益・販売）におけるレベニューマネージメント、予測、キャパシティ最適化、価格設定、メニューエンジニアリング、収益性に関する深い知識。

• 高度な分析力、財務判断力、および商業的判断力。

  • 経営層とのコミュニケーション、影響力行使、ファシリテーション、およびステークホルダー管理における優れたスキル。
  • 高度なExcelおよびプレゼンテーションスキル。POS、予約システム、レポート作成、AI、分析プラットフォームに関する知識があれば尚可。

To lead R&B Revenue Services across EAPAC, driving R&B revenue strategy and performance across a portfolio of hotels and outlets. The role directly manages selected complex assignments, leads and develops the regional R&B Revenue Services team, expands the service footprint, and acts as the senior R&B revenue partner to hotel and regional stakeholders.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Lead R&B Revenue Services and revenue strategy across EAPAC for a portfolio of hotels, restaurants, bars, spas and other ancillary revenue streams.
  • Directly manage selected complex or high-profile hotel assignments and act as the senior R&B revenue partner to hotel leadership.
  • Use demand, capacity, pricing, menu mix, promotions and customer data to identify practical revenue and profitability opportunities.
  • Lead key performance, forecast, budget and strategy reviews with hotel and regional stakeholders.
  • Partner with F&B, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Sales and Digital teams to turn recommendations into action.

Service Growth and Stakeholder Engagement:

  • Expand the R&B Revenue Services footprint by identifying and converting new hotel opportunities.
  • Build compelling business cases and engage GMs, owners and commercial leaders to demonstrate the value of the service.
  • Support hotel onboarding and ensure a smooth transition into the Revenue Services operating model.

Leadership and Team Development:

  • Provide leadership, coaching and technical guidance to PRM R&B colleagues and supporting team members.
  • Act as the escalation point for complex performance, stakeholder, data-quality and implementation issues.
  • Support recruitment, onboarding, training, talent development and succession planning for R&B revenue roles.
  • Build strong relationships with Hotel GMs, F&B leaders, regional commercial teams and owners.

Efficiency, Data and Innovation:

  • Continuously improve ways of working, reporting and team routines to increase productivity and service consistency.
  • Ensure reliable data, clear performance reporting and disciplined follow-up of revenue initiatives.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in Hospitality, Revenue Management, Business or a related field.
  • 10+ years of progressive hospitality, revenue management, commercial strategy or F&B leadership experience.
  • Experience leading complex R&B strategies in a hotel, cluster, portfolio or regional environment.
  • Proven ability to coach teams, influence senior stakeholders and build support for new commercial services.

Technical Skills and Knowledge:

  • Strong knowledge of R&B revenue management, forecasting, capacity optimization, pricing, menu engineering and profitability.
  • Advanced analytical, financial and commercial judgement.
  • Strong executive communication, influencing, facilitation and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Advanced Excel and presentation skills; knowledge of POS, reservation, reporting, AI and analytics platforms is advantageous.

Job Category

Language Requirement

Description & requirements

Description

Dołącz do zespołu obsługującego klientów jednej z najpopularniejszych marek na świecie. Rozwiń kompetencje przyszłości w obszarze obsługi klienta opartej o nowoczesne rozwiązania (CX) razem z 1200 konsultantami i konsultantkami w całej Polsce!

U nas otrzymasz:

  • Wynagrodzenie w wysokości 7300 zł brutto + premię (do 1000 zł brutto)
  • Możliwość pracy w biurze (Gdańsk, Olsztyn), domu (całkowicie zdalnie) lub w trybie hybrydowym.
  • Szkolenie wdrażające i wsparcie w codziennej pracy.
  • W pierwszych 3 miesiącach rozwiniesz umiejętność komunikacji i prowadzenia rozmów w założonych ramach.
  • Realne możliwości awansu - ponad 90% rekrutacji na wyższe stanowiska wygrywają nasi wewnętrzni pracownicy.
  • Program poleceń pracowniczych - do 3000 zł brutto za zatrudnienie pracownika z Twojego polecenia.
  • Konsultacje z psychologiem, karta sportowa (Medicover Sport), opieka medyczna (Medicover), dofinansowanie wypoczynku, kafeteria Worksmile, zniżki na produkty naszych partnerów i wiele więcej!

Jak wygląda dzień pracy?

Zapoznajemy się z bieżącą sytuacją i zmianami w procedurach. Udzielamy odpowiedzi na pytania klientów spływające do nas drogą telefoniczną. Udzielamy porad technicznych, umawiamy wizyty serwisowe. Proponujemy dokupienie korzystnego ubezpieczenia sprzętu AGD na wypadek usterki w przyszłości. Wiemy, że w przypadku nieco trudniejszych zgłoszeń możemy liczyć na wsparcie zespołu i Team Leadera.

Wyróżniają Cię:

  • Dobra umiejętność obsługi komputera - wszystkie zadania wykonujemy elektronicznie.
  • Biegła znajomość języka niemieckiego (min. C1) - niezbędna do obsługi klientów.
  • Wykształcenie co najmniej średnie (matura).
  • Umiejętność słuchania i czytania ze zrozumieniem, tworzenia jasnych wypowiedzi z szacunkiem do drugiej osoby.
  • Dyspozycyjność w godzinach 8-18 od poniedziałku do soboty ( 40 godzin tygodniowo)
  • Z doświadczenia wiemy, że kandydaci, którzy mają kompetencje, mają także tendencję do zaniżania oceny swoich umiejętności. Dlatego daj sobie szansę i aplikuj!

Wymagania pracy zdalnej:

Stałe łącze internetowe, w technologii kablowej (np. ADSL, światłowód), minimalna prędkość pobierania 5 Mbps – minimalna prędkość wysyłania 2 Mbps.

O nas

W Transcom jesteśmy nieustannie zaangażowani w relacje między sobą i naszymi klientami. Każdego dnia ktoś nowy zaczyna z nami przygodę i wykorzystuje swój potencjał, przekształcając go w umiejętności przyszłości. Doceniamy ciężką pracę, grę zespołową i wzajemną pomoc, wspieramy pozytywne i trwałe zmiany. Tacy właśnie jesteśmy, dbamy o siebie i od samego początku sobie kibicujemy, a przy odpowiednim nastawieniu nie ma przed nami ograniczeń i możemy zajść naprawdę daleko.

🚀 Wer wir sind

DigitalCheckIn ist die Nachweisplattform für Anwesenheiten. Unternehmen, unter anderem aus kritischen Infrastrukturen (KRITIS), und Bildungsträger weisen damit nach, wer wann wo war, statt Listen abzugleichen und nachzutragen.

Unsere Vision: Dokumentieren tun viele, nachweisen können es die wenigsten. Wir wollen, dass jede Schulung, jede Unterweisung und jeder Kurs im DACH-Raum einen Nachweis hat, der hält.

Wo wir stehen: Über 7,5 Millionen Anwesenheiten wurden bereits mit DigitalCheckIn erfasst. Du verkaufst ein Produkt, das im Einsatz ist.

Aufgaben

🎯 Wen wir suchen

Jeder neue Kunde beginnt bei uns mit einem Gespräch, das du eröffnest. Du sprichst potenzielle Kunden per Telefon und LinkedIn an, findest den richtigen Ansprechpartner, klärst im Erstgespräch den Bedarf und vereinbarst einen qualifizierten Termin für unser Sales-Team.

Demos, Angebote und Abschlüsse übernimmt das Sales-Team. Dein Fokus ist Akquise, jeden Tag.

Gemessen wirst du an Terminen, die tatsächlich stattfinden und aus denen echte Verkaufschancen entstehen.

Qualifikation

🤷 Was uns komplett egal ist

Woher du kommst, welches Geschlecht du hast, wie alt du bist und welchen Schulabschluss du hast.

✅ Was uns wichtig ist: genau zwei Dinge

  1. Motivation. Du willst neue Kunden aufmachen und mit Menschen in Kontakt kommen. Du suchst nach Möglichkeiten und nach Lösungen, wenn etwas klemmt. Und du willst gemeinsam mit einem Unternehmen wachsen.

  2. Erfahrung. Du hast schon einmal Cold Outreach gemacht und weißt, worauf du dich einlässt.

Da du mit deutschsprachigen Kunden telefonierst, brauchst du sehr gutes Deutsch.

Benefits

💰 Was du bekommst

  • leistungsabhängige variable Vergütung für qualifizierte Termine, mit Accelerator bei Zielübererfüllung

  • zusätzliche Beteiligung an Kundenabschlüssen, die aus deinen Terminen entstehen

  • klare Ziele und transparente Vergütungsregeln

  • strukturierte Einarbeitung in Produkt, Zielgruppen und Gesprächsführung

  • remote möglich, direkter Draht zum Gründer

📩 Bewerbung

Schick uns zwei Dinge:

  1. Ein kurzes Video. Wo willst du in den nächsten Jahren hin? Worauf hast du Lust? Und warum passt das, was du hier gelesen hast, zu dem, was du willst? (Den Link zu deinem Video trägst du im Bewerbungsformular ein. Handyaufnahme reicht.)

  2. Deinen CV, maximal eine Seite.
